```json
      "$ref": "#/$defs/ColorsSection"
    },
    "typography": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/TypographySection"
    },
    "spacing": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/SpacingSection"
    },
    "borders": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/BordersSection"
    },
    "shadows": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/ShadowsSection"
    },
    "custom_properties": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/CustomPropertiesSection"
    },
    "raw_computed": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/RawComputedSection"
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false,

  "$defs": {

    "ConfidenceLevel": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": ["ALTA", "MEDIA", "BAIXA"],
      "description": "Nivel de confianca da extracao. ALTA (>80%): evidencia direta de CSS custom property ou computed style consistente em multiplos elementos. MEDIA (50-80%): inferido por heuristica de frequencia ou posicao DOM. BAIXA (<50%): ambiguo, multiplos candidatos possiveis."
    },

    "CoverageMetrics": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Metricas de cobertura da extracao. Permite avaliar se a extracao foi completa ou parcial.",
      "required": ["elements_analyzed", "elements_total"],
      "properties": {
        "elements_analyzed": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "Numero de elementos DOM que tiveram computed style extraido."
        },
        "elements_total": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "Total estimado de elementos no DOM (document.querySelectorAll('*').length)."
        },
        "stylesheets_accessed": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "Numero de stylesheets cujas cssRules foram acessiveis."
        },
        "stylesheets_blocked": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "Numero de stylesheets bloqueadas por CORS (SecurityError)."
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },

    "ContrastPair": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Par de contraste WCAG entre duas cores extraidas.",
      "required": ["foreground", "background", "ratio", "wcag_aa", "wcag_aaa"],
      "properties": {
        "foreground": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Cor de primeiro plano (hex)."
        },
        "background": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Cor de fundo (hex)."
        },
        "ratio": {
          "type": "number",
          "minimum": 1,
          "description": "Ratio de contraste (e.g., 4.5, 7.2). Minimo 1:1."
        },
        "wcag_aa": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "description": "True se ratio >= 4.5:1 (texto normal) ou >= 3:1 (texto grande / UI)."
        },
        "wcag_aaa": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "description": "True se ratio >= 7:1 (texto normal) ou >= 4.5:1 (texto grande)."
        },
        "context": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Contexto DOM onde este par aparece (e.g., 'body text on background', 'button label on primary')."
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },

    "Metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Metadados da extracao: URL fonte, data, versao, metricas de cobertura.",
      "required": ["source_url", "extraction_date", "extractor_version", "coverage"],
      "properties": {
        "source_url": {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "uri",
          "description": "URL de onde os tokens foram extraidos."
        },
        "extraction_date": {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time",
          "description": "Data/hora da extracao em ISO 8601."
        },
        "extractor_version": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Versao do design-extractor (e.g., '1.0.0')."
        },
        "playwright_version": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Versao do Playwright usada na extracao."
        },
        "coverage": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/CoverageMetrics"
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },

    "ColorRef": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Representa um unico token de cor extraido.",
      "required": ["value", "confidence"],
      "properties": {
        "value": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Valor da cor em qualquer formato CSS valido (hex, hsl, oklch, rgba)."
        },
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Nome semantico inferido ou herdado de custom property (e.g., 'primary', 'background')."
        },
        "confidence": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ConfidenceLevel"
        },
        "candidates": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "description": "Valores candidatos alternativos quando confidence e MEDIA/BAIXA. Resultado de K-means++ clustering (ADR-8)."
        },
        "usage": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Onde a cor aparece (e.g., 'body background', 'heading color', 'button background')."
        },
        "hsl": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Valor em HSL para consumo Tailwind (e.g., '222.2 84% 4.9%')."
        },
        "oklch": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Valor em OKLCH (e.g., 'oklch(0.73 0.11 78)')."
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },

    "ColorPalette": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Mapa de nome do token → ColorRef. Chave e o nome do token de cor.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/ColorRef"
      }
    },

    "SemanticMapping": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Mapeamento semantico de cores (primary, secondary, success, warning, error, info, etc.).",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/ColorRef"
      }
    },

    "DarkMode": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Variante dark mode detectada no site.",
      "required": ["enabled"],
      "properties": {
        "enabled": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "description": "True se .dark class ou prefers-color-scheme: dark foi detectado."
        },
        "palette": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ColorPalette"
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },

    "ColorsSection": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Secao de cores: palette, mapeamento semantico, dark mode, pares de contraste WCAG.",
      "required": ["palette", "confidence"],
      "properties": {
        "palette": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ColorPalette"
        },
        "semantic_mapping": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SemanticMapping"
        },
        "dark_mode": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/DarkMode"
        },
        "contrast_pairs": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/ContrastPair"
          },
          "description": "Pares de contraste WCAG entre cores extraidas (ADR-11)."
        },
        "confidence": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ConfidenceLevel",
          "description": "Confidence overall da secao de cores."
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },

    "FontFamilyRef": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Uma font family detectada na extracao.",
      "required": ["family", "source", "confidence"],
      "properties": {
        "family": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Nome da font family (e.g., 'Inter', 'system-ui')."
        },
        "source": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["system", "google", "custom", "unknown"],
          "description": "Origem da font. google = Google Fonts URL detectada. custom = self-hosted @font-face. system = stack de sistema."
        },
        "confidence": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ConfidenceLevel"
        },
        "weight_range": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "integer",
            "minimum": 100,
            "maximum": 900
          },
          "description": "Pesos detectados (e.g., [400, 600, 700])."
        },
        "usage": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["heading", "body", "mono", "accent", "unknown"],
          "description": "Classificacao de uso inferida."
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },

    "TypeScaleEntry": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Uma entrada na escala tipografica extraida.",
      "required": ["size", "confidence"],
      "properties": {
        "size": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Tamanho em CSS (e.g., '1rem', '16px')."
        },
        "line_height": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Line-height associada (e.g., '1.5', '24px')."
        },
        "weight": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Font-weight predominante neste tamanho (e.g., '400', '700')."
        },
        "confidence": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ConfidenceLevel"
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },

    "TypographySection": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Secao de tipografia: font families e escala tipografica.",
      "required": ["font_families", "scale", "confidence"],
      "properties": {
        "font_families": {
          "type": "object",
          "additionalProperties": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/FontFamilyRef"
          },
          "description": "Mapa de nome → FontFamilyRef. Chave e o identificador da family (e.g., 'heading', 'body', 'mono')."
        },
        "scale": {
          "type": "object",
          "additionalProperties": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/TypeScaleEntry"
          },
          "description": "Mapa de nome da escala → TypeScaleEntry (e.g., 'xs', 'sm', 'base', 'lg')."
        },
        "confidence": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ConfidenceLevel",
          "description": "Confidence overall da secao de tipografia."
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },

    "SpacingSection": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Secao de spacing: unidade base e escala de espacamento.",
      "required": ["base_unit", "scale", "confidence"],
      "properties": {
        "base_unit": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Valor unitario do sistema de espacamento (e.g., '4px', '0.25rem')."
        },
        "scale": {
          "type": "object",
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "description": "Mapa de nome → valor de spacing (e.g., { '1': '4px', '2': '8px', '4': '16px' })."
        },
        "confidence": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ConfidenceLevel",
          "description": "Confidence overall da secao de spacing."
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },

    "BorderRef": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Um token de border extraido.",
      "required": ["confidence"],
      "properties": {
        "width": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Border-width (e.g., '1px', '2px')."
        },
        "style": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Border-style (e.g., 'solid', 'dashed')."
        },
        "radius": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Border-radius (e.g., '8px', '0.5rem', '50%')."
        },
        "confidence": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ConfidenceLevel"
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },

    "BordersSection": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Secao de borders: width e radius detectados.",
      "required": ["confidence"],
      "properties": {
        "width": {
          "type": "object",
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "description": "Mapa de nome → valor de border-width (e.g., { 'default': '1px', 'thick': '2px' })."
        },
        "radius": {
          "type": "object",
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "description": "Mapa de nome → valor de border-radius (e.g., { 'sm': '4px', 'md': '8px', 'full': '9999px' })."
        },
        "confidence": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ConfidenceLevel",
          "description": "Confidence overall da secao de borders."
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },

    "ShadowRef": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Um token de shadow extraido.",
      "required": ["value", "confidence"],
      "properties": {
        "value": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Valor CSS completo de box-shadow."
        },
        "confidence": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ConfidenceLevel"
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },

    "ShadowsSection": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Secao de shadows: sombras detectadas, indexadas por nome semantico.",
      "required": ["confidence"],
      "properties": {
        "confidence": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ConfidenceLevel",
          "description": "Confidence overall da secao de shadows."
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/ShadowRef"
      }
    },

    "CustomPropertyEntry": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Uma CSS custom property extraida de :root.",
      "required": ["value", "type", "confidence"],
      "properties": {
        "value": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Valor da custom property."
        },
        "type": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["color", "size", "number", "string", "unknown"],
          "description": "Tipo inferido do valor."
        },
        "confidence": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ConfidenceLevel"
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },

    "CustomPropertiesSection": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "CSS custom properties como campo de primeira classe (ADR-12). Chave = nome da propriedade (e.g., '--brand-primary', '--spacing-base').",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/CustomPropertyEntry"
      }
    },

    "RawComputedSection": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Map de selector → computed style values. Artefato de debug, cap 200 entries (ADR-6).",
      "maxProperties": 200,
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Referência: references/squad/data/design-tokens-spec.yaml

```yaml
# Design Tokens Specification - Single Source of Truth
# Version: 1.0.0
# Last Updated: 2026-01-05
#
# IMPORTANT: This is the TEMPLATE for design tokens structure.
# Brand-specific values (colors, fonts) must come from workspace/ui/{brand}/brand.json.
# This file defines the TOKEN STRUCTURE and SEMANTIC ROLES, not brand values.
#
# Usage:
#   - *validate-tokens: Validates code against this spec
#   - *contrast-check: Validates color contrast ratios
#   - Subagents: Must read this file before creating components
#
# Brand values are loaded from: workspace/ui/{brand}/brand.json

metadata:
  version: "2.0.0"
  brand: "{brand}"  # Replaced at runtime from workspace/ui/{brand}/brand.json
  theme: "dark"     # Default theme; brand.json may override
  wcag_target: "AA"  # AA = 4.5:1 normal, 3:1 large | AAA = 7:1 normal, 4.5:1 large

# =============================================================================
# COLORS
# =============================================================================
colors:
  # Primary Brand Colors — values loaded from workspace/ui/{brand}/brand.json
  primary:
    accent:
      value: "var(--color-primary)"  # From brand.json
      usage: "Primary actions, highlights, brand accent"
      contrast_on_dark: ">= 4.5:1"  # Must pass AA
    accent_dark:
      value: "var(--color-primary-dark)"  # From brand.json
      usage: "Hover states, borders, secondary emphasis"
      contrast_on_dark: ">= 4.5:1"  # Must pass AA
    accent_light:
      value: "var(--color-primary-light)"  # From brand.json
      usage: "Highlights, focus rings"
      contrast_on_dark: ">= 4.5:1"  # Must pass AA

  # Background Colors
  background:
    base:
      value: "#0A0A0F"
      hsl: "240 20% 5%"
      usage: "Main background"
    elevated:
      value: "#111116"
      hsl: "240 14% 8%"
      usage: "Cards, panels, elevated surfaces"
    surface:
      value: "#1a1a1f"
      hsl: "240 8% 11%"
      usage: "Interactive surfaces, inputs"
    overlay:
      value: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8)"
      usage: "Modal overlays, dropdowns"

  # Text Colors
  text:
    primary:
      value: "#FFFFFF"
      opacity: "100%"
      usage: "Headings, primary content"
    secondary:
      value: "#A1A1AA"
      hsl: "240 5% 65%"
      usage: "Body text, descriptions"
    muted:
      value: "#71717A"
      hsl: "240 4% 46%"
      usage: "Placeholders, disabled text, captions"
    inverse:
      value: "#0A0A0F"
      usage: "Text on light backgrounds (buttons)"

  # Semantic Colors
  semantic:
    success:
      value: "#22C55E"
      hsl: "142 71% 45%"
      usage: "Success states, confirmations"
    warning:
      value: "#F59E0B"
      hsl: "38 92% 50%"
      usage: "Warnings, caution states"
    error:
      value: "#EF4444"
      hsl: "0 84% 60%"
      usage: "Errors, destructive actions"
    info:
      value: "#3B82F6"
      hsl: "217 91% 60%"
      usage: "Information, links"

  # Border Colors
  border:
    default:
      value: "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)"
      usage: "Default borders"
    subtle:
      value: "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)"
      usage: "Subtle separators"
    emphasis:
      value: "rgba(var(--color-primary-rgb), 0.3)"
      usage: "Emphasized borders (primary color)"

# =============================================================================
# TYPOGRAPHY
# =============================================================================
typography:
  # Font Families
  families:
    sans:
      value: "'Inter', sans-serif"
      usage: "Body text, UI elements"
    serif:
      value: "'Source Serif 4', serif"
      usage: "Long-form content, articles"
    display:
      value: "var(--font-family-display)"  # From brand.json (e.g. Rajdhani, Plus Jakarta Sans)
      usage: "Headings, hero text"
    mono:
      value: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace"
      usage: "Code, technical content"

  # Font Sizes (rem based, 1rem = 16px)
  sizes:
    xs:
      value: "0.75rem"    # 12px
      line_height: "1rem"  # 16px
      usage: "Captions, labels"
    sm:
      value: "0.875rem"   # 14px
      line_height: "1.25rem"  # 20px
      usage: "Secondary text, buttons"
    base:
      value: "1rem"       # 16px
      line_height: "1.5rem"   # 24px
      usage: "Body text"
    lg:
      value: "1.125rem"   # 18px
      line_height: "1.75rem"  # 28px
      usage: "Lead paragraphs"
    xl:
      value: "1.25rem"    # 20px
      line_height: "1.75rem"  # 28px
      usage: "Section headings"
    2xl:
      value: "1.5rem"     # 24px
      line_height: "2rem"     # 32px
      usage: "Page headings"
    3xl:
      value: "1.875rem"   # 30px
      line_height: "2.25rem"  # 36px
      usage: "Hero subheadings"
    4xl:
      value: "2.25rem"    # 36px
      line_height: "2.5rem"   # 40px
      usage: "Hero headings"
    5xl:
      value: "3rem"       # 48px
      line_height: "1"
      usage: "Display headings"

  # Font Weights
  weights:
    normal:
      value: "400"
      usage: "Body text"
    medium:
      value: "500"
      usage: "Emphasis, buttons"
    semibold:
      value: "600"
      usage: "Headings, labels"
    bold:
      value: "700"
      usage: "Strong emphasis"

# =============================================================================
# SPACING
# =============================================================================
spacing:
  # Base unit: 4px (0.25rem)
  scale:
    0:
      value: "0"
      usage: "No spacing"
    px:
      value: "1px"
      usage: "Hairline borders"
    0.5:
      value: "0.125rem"   # 2px
      usage: "Micro spacing"
    1:
      value: "0.25rem"    # 4px
      usage: "Tight spacing"
    2:
      value: "0.5rem"     # 8px
      usage: "Small gaps"
    3:
      value: "0.75rem"    # 12px
      usage: "Default gap"
    4:
      value: "1rem"       # 16px
      usage: "Standard padding"
    5:
      value: "1.25rem"    # 20px
      usage: "Medium padding"
    6:
      value: "1.5rem"     # 24px
      usage: "Section padding"
    8:
      value: "2rem"       # 32px
      usage: "Large padding"
    10:
      value: "2.5rem"     # 40px
      usage: "XL padding"
    12:
      value: "3rem"       # 48px
      usage: "Section margins"
    16:
      value: "4rem"       # 64px
      usage: "Page sections"
    20:
      value: "5rem"       # 80px
      usage: "Major sections"
    24:
      value: "6rem"       # 96px
      usage: "Hero spacing"

# =============================================================================
# BORDERS & RADIUS
# =============================================================================
borders:
  width:
    none:
      value: "0"
    default:
      value: "1px"
    2:
      value: "2px"
      usage: "Emphasis borders"

  radius:
    none:
      value: "0"
    sm:
      value: "0.25rem"    # 4px
      usage: "Small elements (badges)"
    md:
      value: "0.375rem"   # 6px
      usage: "Buttons, inputs"
    lg:
      value: "0.5rem"     # 8px
      usage: "Cards"
    xl:
      value: "0.75rem"    # 12px
      usage: "Larger cards"
    2xl:
      value: "1rem"       # 16px
      usage: "Modal corners"
    full:
      value: "9999px"
      usage: "Pills, avatars"

# =============================================================================
# SHADOWS
# =============================================================================
shadows:
  none:
    value: "none"
  sm:
    value: "0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)"
    usage: "Subtle elevation"
  md:
    value: "0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)"
    usage: "Cards, dropdowns"
  lg:
    value: "0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)"
    usage: "Modals, popovers"
  xl:
    value: "0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)"
    usage: "Floating elements"
  glow:
    value: "0 0 20px rgba(var(--color-primary-rgb), 0.3)"
    usage: "Primary element glow"

# =============================================================================
# MOTION
# =============================================================================
motion:
  duration:
    instant:
      value: "0ms"
      usage: "No animation"
    fast:
      value: "100ms"
      usage: "Micro-interactions"
    normal:
      value: "200ms"
      usage: "Standard transitions"
    slow:
      value: "300ms"
      usage: "Page transitions"
    slower:
      value: "500ms"
      usage: "Complex animations"

  easing:
    linear:
      value: "cubic-bezier(0, 0, 1, 1)"
    ease_in:
      value: "cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1)"
      usage: "Exit animations"
    ease_out:
      value: "cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1)"
      usage: "Enter animations"
    ease_in_out:
      value: "cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)"
      usage: "Standard transitions"

# =============================================================================
# COMPONENT SPECS
# =============================================================================
components:
  button:
    padding:
      sm: "0.5rem 1rem"     # py-2 px-4
      md: "0.625rem 1.25rem" # py-2.5 px-5
      lg: "0.75rem 1.5rem"   # py-3 px-6
    border_radius: "0.375rem"  # rounded-md
    font_size: "0.875rem"      # text-sm
    font_weight: "500"         # font-medium
    min_height:
      sm: "2rem"      # 32px
      md: "2.5rem"    # 40px
      lg: "3rem"      # 48px
    variants:
      primary:
        bg: "var(--color-primary)"
        text: "var(--color-background)"
        hover_bg: "var(--color-primary-dark)"
      secondary:
        bg: "var(--color-surface)"
        text: "var(--color-foreground)"
        border: "var(--color-border)"
      outline:
        bg: "transparent"
        text: "var(--color-primary)"
        border: "rgba(var(--color-primary-rgb), 0.5)"
      ghost:
        bg: "transparent"
        text: "#A1A1AA"
        hover_bg: "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)"
      destructive:
        bg: "#EF4444"
        text: "#FFFFFF"
        hover_bg: "#DC2626"

  input:
    height:
      sm: "2rem"      # 32px
      md: "2.5rem"    # 40px
      lg: "3rem"      # 48px
    padding: "0.5rem 0.75rem"  # py-2 px-3
    border_radius: "0.375rem"   # rounded-md
    border: "1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)"
    bg: "#1a1a1f"
    focus_ring: "2px solid rgba(var(--color-primary-rgb), 0.5)"

  card:
    padding:
      sm: "1rem"      # p-4
      md: "1.5rem"    # p-6
      lg: "2rem"      # p-8
    border_radius: "0.75rem"  # rounded-xl
    bg: "#111116"
    border: "1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)"

  modal:
    max_width:
      sm: "24rem"     # 384px
      md: "28rem"     # 448px
      lg: "32rem"     # 512px
      xl: "36rem"     # 576px
    padding: "1.5rem"   # p-6
    border_radius: "1rem"  # rounded-2xl
    bg: "#111116"
    overlay_bg: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8)"

# =============================================================================
# VALIDATION RULES
# =============================================================================
validation:
  # Colors that should NEVER be hardcoded — use semantic tokens instead
  # Brand-specific hex values are loaded at runtime from workspace/ui/{brand}/brand.json
  forbidden_patterns:
    - "Raw hex values (#XXXXXX) — use var(--color-*) tokens"
    - "Raw rgba with brand colors — use rgba(var(--color-*-rgb), opacity)"
    - "Hardcoded font families — use var(--font-family-*) tokens"

  # Allowed patterns for colors
  allowed_patterns:
    - "var(--"           # CSS variables
    - "hsl(var("         # Tailwind CSS vars
    - "colors."          # Token references
    - "DS_"              # Design system constants
    - "studio-"          # Dynamic studio colors
    - "brand-"           # Brand palette

  # Minimum contrast ratios (WCAG AA)
  contrast_requirements:
    normal_text: 4.5
    large_text: 3.0      # 18px+ or 14px bold
    ui_components: 3.0   # Non-text elements
```


## Referência: references/squad/data/ds-page-types-registry.yaml

```yaml
version: "2.0.0"
created: "2026-03-20"
language: "en"
purpose: "Machine-readable registry of design-system page types. It tells AI which pages to create, which sections each page must contain, and which shadcn/ui primitives plus Tailwind patterns should be used."

stack_contract:
  styling: "Tailwind CSS v4"
  primitives: "shadcn/ui"
  charts: "Recharts through the local shadcn chart wrapper"
  rule: "Use shadcn/ui primitive names and Tailwind pattern names only. Do not reference starter-specific component aliases in this registry."

generation_rules:
  - "Describe what each page must contain, not one fixed final layout."
  - "A page may vary in tone, density, color strategy, and composition as long as the required sections and contracts are preserved."
  - "When a page needs a richer block than raw shadcn primitives, use a composed block from composed_blocks."
  - "If a page is data-heavy, prefer tabs, table, chart, scroll-area, and sticky sidebars before inventing custom widgets."
  - "If a page is visual, prefer grid, gallery, frame, and editorial patterns before adding new component abstractions."

tiers:
  0: "Core foundations"
  1: "Core component documentation"
  2: "Advanced system patterns"
  3: "Showcase and expression"

variation_axes:
  tone:
    - "minimal"
    - "premium"
    - "bold"
    - "cinematic"
    - "editorial"
    - "developer-focused"
    - "corporate"
    - "playful"
  density:
    - "compact"
    - "balanced"
    - "generous"
  color_mode:
    - "light"
    - "dark"
    - "adaptive"
  chrome_style:
    - "quiet"
    - "productized"
    - "magazine"
    - "presentation"
  demo_depth:
    - "minimal"
    - "standard"
    - "deep"

available_primitives:
  shadcn_ui:
    - "accordion"
    - "avatar"
    - "badge"
    - "breadcrumb"
    - "button"
    - "card"
    - "chart"
    - "checkbox"
    - "collapsible"
    - "context-menu"
    - "dialog"
    - "dropdown-menu"
    - "hover-card"
    - "input"
    - "label"
    - "popover"
    - "progress"
    - "radio-group"
    - "scroll-area"
    - "select"
    - "separator"
    - "sheet"
    - "skeleton"
    - "slider"
    - "switch"
    - "table"
    - "tabs"
    - "textarea"
    - "toggle"
    - "toggle-group"
    - "tooltip"
  tailwind_patterns:
    - "page-shell"
    - "section-stack"
    - "content-width-sm"
    - "content-width-md"
    - "content-width-lg"
    - "responsive-grid-2"
    - "responsive-grid-3"
    - "responsive-grid-4"
    - "token-swatch-grid"
    - "comparison-grid"
    - "stats-strip"
    - "sticky-aside"
    - "editorial-columns"
    - "demo-stage"
    - "gallery-grid"
    - "masonry-grid"
    - "toolbar-row"
    - "step-rail"
    - "side-by-side"
    - "bento-grid"
    - "marquee-strip"
    - "tabbed-demo-surface"
    - "scroll-snap-rail"

composed_blocks:
  page_hero:
    purpose: "Standard page opener for a DS route."
    built_from:
      shadcn_ui: ["badge", "separator"]
      tailwind_patterns: ["section-stack", "content-width-md"]
    must_render: ["eyebrow", "page title", "one-paragraph summary"]
  token_swatch:
    purpose: "Reusable token display card for color, spacing, radius, or shadow."
    built_from:
      shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "tooltip"]
      tailwind_patterns: ["token-swatch-grid"]
    must_render: ["token name", "token value", "semantic role", "live preview"]
  specimen_panel:
    purpose: "Typography or icon specimen panel."
    built_from:
      shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "separator"]
      tailwind_patterns: ["section-stack"]
    must_render: ["preview", "metadata", "usage note"]
  demo_card:
    purpose: "Interactive component demo with code or usage notes."
    built_from:
      shadcn_ui: ["card", "tabs", "separator", "button"]
      tailwind_patterns: ["demo-stage", "tabbed-demo-surface"]
    must_render: ["live demo", "variant label", "usage note"]
  state_matrix:
    purpose: "Show default, hover, focus, disabled, loading, and error states."
    built_from:
      shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "tabs", "tooltip"]
      tailwind_patterns: ["comparison-grid"]
    must_render: ["state label", "preview", "state-specific note"]
  metric_card:
    purpose: "Compact status or coverage summary."
    built_from:
      shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "progress"]
      tailwind_patterns: ["stats-strip"]
    must_render: ["metric label", "metric value", "supporting caption"]
  step_block:
    purpose: "Ordered process or rule sequence."
    built_from:
      shadcn_ui: ["badge", "card", "separator"]
      tailwind_patterns: ["step-rail"]
    must_render: ["step number", "step title", "step description"]
  data_demo:
    purpose: "Table or chart showcase with filters."
    built_from:
      shadcn_ui: ["card", "tabs", "select", "button", "chart", "table"]
      tailwind_patterns: ["toolbar-row", "demo-stage"]
    must_render: ["control row", "live data surface", "interpretation note"]
  slide_canvas:
    purpose: "Presentation slide preview or narrative deck section."
    built_from:
      shadcn_ui: ["card", "tabs", "badge"]
      tailwind_patterns: ["gallery-grid", "side-by-side"]
    must_render: ["slide preview", "narrative role", "format note"]

selection_presets:
  mvp:
    description: "Fast starter for a small but credible design system."
    include: ["foundations", "typography", "color-tokens", "spacing-layout", "surfaces", "semantic-tokens", "buttons", "forms"]
  standard:
    description: "Balanced system for most product brands."
    include: ["foundations", "typography", "color-tokens", "spacing-layout", "surfaces", "semantic-tokens", "components-overview", "buttons", "forms", "feedback", "states", "cards", "tables", "navigation", "motion"]
  premium:
    description: "Broader system with data display and expressive pages."
    include: ["foundations", "typography", "color-tokens", "spacing-layout", "surfaces", "semantic-tokens", "token-export", "components-overview", "buttons", "forms", "feedback", "states", "cards", "tables", "lists", "charts", "navigation", "motion", "patterns", "effects", "templates"]
  full:
    description: "Full brandbook-grade system with utility, narrative, and showcase pages."
    include: ["foundations", "typography", "color-tokens", "spacing-layout", "surfaces", "semantic-tokens", "token-export", "components-overview", "buttons", "forms", "feedback", "states", "cards", "tables", "lists", "charts", "navigation", "motion", "patterns", "effects", "icons", "logo", "templates", "lp-sections", "editorial", "moodboard", "seo", "slides"]

page_types:
  foundations:
    tier: 0
    label: "Foundations"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/foundations"]
    purpose: "Entry page that orients the system and links to every foundation layer."
    inclusion_rule: "Always include in any multi-page design system."
    required_sections:
      - id: "page-hero"
        composed_blocks: ["page_hero"]
        shadcn_ui: ["badge", "separator"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["section-stack", "content-width-md"]
        must_render: ["eyebrow", "title", "summary", "system scope"]
      - id: "foundation-grid"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "button"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["responsive-grid-3"]
        must_render: ["foundation cards", "short descriptions", "route links", "coverage cues"]
      - id: "system-status"
        composed_blocks: ["metric_card"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "progress", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["stats-strip"]
        must_render: ["token count", "component count", "coverage summary"]

  typography:
    tier: 0
    label: "Typography"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/typography"]
    purpose: "Document font families, type scale, hierarchy, and reading behavior."
    inclusion_rule: "Always include in any design system."
    required_sections:
      - id: "font-families"
        composed_blocks: ["specimen_panel"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "separator"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["responsive-grid-2"]
        must_render: ["family specimen", "font family name", "fallback stack", "recommended use"]
      - id: "type-scale"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "table", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["section-stack", "content-width-lg"]
        must_render: ["token name", "size", "line-height", "letter-spacing", "live preview"]
      - id: "heading-hierarchy"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "separator", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["section-stack"]
        must_render: ["H1-H6 preview", "usage note", "hierarchy rationale"]
      - id: "body-and-code"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "tabs", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["side-by-side"]
        must_render: ["body copy sample", "small/caption sample", "code sample", "line length guidance"]

  color-tokens:
    tier: 0
    label: "Color Tokens"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/color-tokens"]
    purpose: "Document palette, semantic mapping, surfaces, and contrast behavior."
    inclusion_rule: "Always include in any design system."
    required_sections:
      - id: "accent-and-brand-palette"
        composed_blocks: ["token_swatch"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "tooltip"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["token-swatch-grid"]
        must_render: ["brand colors", "token values", "semantic labels", "light/dark preview"]
      - id: "neutral-scale"
        composed_blocks: ["token_swatch"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "tooltip", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["token-swatch-grid"]
        must_render: ["neutral steps", "foreground/background preview", "value label"]
      - id: "semantic-colors"
        composed_blocks: ["token_swatch"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "tooltip"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["responsive-grid-4"]
        must_render: ["success", "warning", "error", "info", "usage note"]
      - id: "contrast-check"
        shadcn_ui: ["table", "badge", "card"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["content-width-lg"]
        must_render: ["foreground/background pairs", "contrast ratio", "pass/fail status"]

  spacing-layout:
    tier: 0
    label: "Spacing & Layout"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/spacing-layout", "/brandbook/spacing", "/brandbook/spacing-scale", "/brandbook/layering"]
    purpose: "Document spacing scales, breakpoint logic, layout rails, and layering rules."
    inclusion_rule: "Always include in any design system."
    required_sections:
      - id: "spacing-scale"
        composed_blocks: ["token_swatch"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "separator"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["section-stack"]
        must_render: ["token name", "pixel/rem value", "visual bar", "usage note"]
      - id: "layout-rails"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "tabs", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["side-by-side", "demo-stage"]
        must_render: ["container widths", "column behavior", "gutter strategy", "layout examples"]
      - id: "breakpoints-and-layering"
        shadcn_ui: ["table", "badge", "card"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["content-width-lg"]
        must_render: ["breakpoints", "intended device targets", "z-index or layering map"]

  surfaces:
    tier: 0
    label: "Surfaces & Borders"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/surfaces"]
    purpose: "Show elevation, borders, corner radius, and surface hierarchy."
    inclusion_rule: "Always include in any design system."
    required_sections:
      - id: "elevation-scale"
        composed_blocks: ["token_swatch"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["responsive-grid-3"]
        must_render: ["surface preview", "elevation token", "shadow value", "recommended usage"]
      - id: "border-and-radius"
        composed_blocks: ["token_swatch"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "tooltip"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["responsive-grid-4"]
        must_render: ["border strength", "radius scale", "preview tile"]
      - id: "surface-hierarchy"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "separator", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["side-by-side"]
        must_render: ["background", "panel", "card", "overlay", "hierarchy guidance"]

  semantic-tokens:
    tier: 0
    label: "Semantic Tokens"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/semantic-tokens"]
    purpose: "Explain semantic token roles independently from raw visual values."
    inclusion_rule: "Include whenever semantic aliasing exists."
    required_sections:
      - id: "semantic-map"
        shadcn_ui: ["table", "badge", "card"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["content-width-lg"]
        must_render: ["semantic token", "raw token source", "intended context", "theme mode behavior"]
      - id: "surface-and-content-pairs"
        composed_blocks: ["token_swatch"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "tooltip"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["comparison-grid"]
        must_render: ["surface token", "text token", "pair preview", "accessibility note"]

  token-export:
    tier: 2
    label: "Token Export"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/token-export"]
    purpose: "Expose exportable token structures for engineering handoff."
    inclusion_rule: "Include when the design system has cross-tool or runtime handoff needs."
    required_sections:
      - id: "export-targets"
        shadcn_ui: ["tabs", "card", "badge", "button"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["tabbed-demo-surface"]
        must_render: ["target formats", "copy/export actions", "format explanation"]
      - id: "token-contract"
        shadcn_ui: ["table", "scroll-area", "card"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["content-width-lg"]
        must_render: ["token keys", "semantic grouping", "delivery notes"]

  components-overview:
    tier: 1
    label: "Components"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/components"]
    purpose: "Overview page for the component catalog and grouping logic."
    inclusion_rule: "Include whenever the system documents more than one component family."
    required_sections:
      - id: "catalog-hero"
        composed_blocks: ["page_hero"]
        shadcn_ui: ["badge", "separator"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["section-stack", "content-width-md"]
        must_render: ["title", "catalog scope", "component family count"]
      - id: "component-family-grid"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "button"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["responsive-grid-3"]
        must_render: ["family card", "family description", "component count", "route or jump link"]
      - id: "coverage-summary"
        composed_blocks: ["metric_card"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "progress", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["stats-strip"]
        must_render: ["coverage by family", "maturity status", "missing areas"]

  buttons:
    tier: 1
    label: "Buttons"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/buttons"]
    purpose: "Document button variants, sizes, icon rules, grouping, and CTA hierarchy."
    inclusion_rule: "Always include when the system is interactive."
    required_sections:
      - id: "variant-matrix"

      - id: "state-coverage"

        must_render: ["default", "hover", "focus", "disabled", "loading"]
      - id: "button-groups-and-cta-rules"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "separator", "badge"]

  forms:

    required_sections:
      - id: "field-primitives"
        shadcn_ui: ["input", "textarea", "select", "checkbox", "radio-group", "switch", "label", "card", "tabs"]

      - id: "form-layout-patterns"

      - id: "validation-and-submission"

  feedback:
    tier: 1

        tailwind_patterns: ["comparison-grid"]

  cards:

    purpose: "Show card families, density, content hierarchy, and media behavior."
    inclusion_rule: "Include whenever the product uses repeatable content containers."

      - id: "card-family-gallery"
        composed_blocks: ["demo_card"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "tabs", "button", "avatar"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["gallery-grid", "demo-stage"]
        must_render: ["basic card", "feature card", "article card", "profile or team card"]
      - id: "content-hierarchy-rules"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "separator", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["side-by-side"]
        must_render: ["header/body/footer rules", "media placement rules", "density guidance"]
      - id: "state-and-layout-variants"
        composed_blocks: ["state_matrix"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "tabs", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["comparison-grid"]
        must_render: ["interactive card", "static card", "selected card", "disabled card"]

  tables:
    tier: 1
    label: "Tables"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/tables"]
    purpose: "Document structured data tables, density, and row actions."
    inclusion_rule: "Include whenever the product exposes tabular data."

      - id: "table-foundation"
        composed_blocks: ["data_demo"]
        shadcn_ui: ["table", "card", "badge", "select", "button", "scroll-area"]

      - id: "row-actions-and-status"
        shadcn_ui: ["dropdown-menu", "badge", "button", "tooltip", "table"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["content-width-lg"]
        must_render: ["row action menu", "selection state", "status badge", "empty rows behavior"]

  lists:
    tier: 1
    label: "Lists"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/lists"]
    purpose: "Document list items, metadata density, and sequence patterns."
    inclusion_rule: "Include when the system supports feeds, documents, or repeated content entries."
    required_sections:
      - id: "list-item-families"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "avatar", "separator", "button"]

      - id: "selection-and-grouping"

  charts:

    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/charts"]

    inclusion_rule: "Include when the product presents trends, breakdowns, or performance data."

      - id: "chart-gallery"

      - id: "chart-usage-rules"

  navigation:

    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/navigation"]

      - id: "local-and-contextual-nav"
```

## Referência: references/squad/data/ds-reference-architectures.md

# Design System Reference Architectures — Comparative Guide

**Purpose:** Quick reference for comparing major DS architectures when making design decisions

---

## Material Design 3 (Google)

**Philosophy:** Expressive, personal, adaptive

- **Dynamic Color:** Material You generates palettes from user wallpaper/preferences
- **Tokens:** Mode-aware semantic tokens with tonal palettes (0-100 scale)
- **Components:** ~30 core components, highly customizable via theme
- **A11y:** Color contrast validation built into palette generation
- **Governance:** Centralized by Google, open-source implementations
- **Tooling:** Material Theme Builder, Figma plugin, style-dictionary export

**Best for:** Consumer apps, products wanting personality and expressiveness

---

## Fluent 2 (Microsoft)

**Philosophy:** Clarity, system, productive

- **Components:** Compound component architecture, slot-based customization
- **Tokens:** 3-layer (global → alias → component), cross-platform naming
- **Cross-platform:** Native implementations per platform (not web wrappers)
- **A11y:** Built-in ARIA, Tabster focus management, high contrast via tokens
- **Governance:** Centralized Microsoft team, tiny core doc team
- **Tooling:** @fluentui/react-components, Griffel CSS-in-JS

**Best for:** Enterprise/productivity apps, cross-platform consistency

---

## Carbon (IBM)

**Philosophy:** Enterprise-scale, granular, governed

- **Tokens:** Most granular token system in industry (1,500+ tokens in v11)
- **Components:** ~50 components, heavy enterprise forms/data focus
- **Theming:** 4 built-in themes (white, g10, g90, g100) + custom themes
- **A11y:** IBM Equal Access Toolkit integration, automated a11y testing
- **Governance:** Federated model with dedicated contribution process
- **Tooling:** Carbon DevTools browser extension, Sass-based, migrating to tokens

**Best for:** Complex enterprise applications, data-heavy interfaces, regulated industries

---

## Spectrum (Adobe)

**Philosophy:** Adaptive, inclusive, global

- **Scale:** Desktop and mobile scales via token switching
- **Tokens:** Localization-aware (RTL, CJK typography), accessibility tokens
- **Components:** React Spectrum (React The Architect + React Stately architecture)
- **A11y:** React The Architect — most comprehensive accessible component hooks library
- **Governance:** Centralized Adobe team, React The Architect is open-source
- **Tooling:** React The Architect (hooks-only, unstyled), React Spectrum (styled)

**Best for:** Creative tools, global/multilingual apps, custom-styled accessible components

---

## Comparison Matrix

| Dimension | Material 3 | Fluent 2 | Carbon | Spectrum |
|-----------|-----------|----------|--------|----------|
| **Token approach** | Tonal palettes + semantic | 3-layer global/alias/component | Granular 1,500+ | Scale/locale-aware |
| **Component model** | Customizable theme | Compound/slots | Enterprise forms | Hooks + styled |
| **A11y strategy** | Palette contrast | Built-in ARIA + Tabster | IBM Equal Access | React The Architect hooks |
| **Governance** | Centralized (Google) | Centralized (Microsoft) | Federated | Centralized (Adobe) |
| **Cross-platform** | MDC-Web, Android, iOS, Flutter | Web, iOS, Android, Windows | Web primary | Web primary |
| **Token format** | Custom JSON | Custom JSON | Sass → tokens | Custom JSON |
| **DTCG adoption** | Partial | Partial | Migrating | Partial |
| **Open source** | Yes (MDC) | Yes (@fluentui) | Yes (carbon) | Yes (react-aria) |

---

## When to Reference Each

| Scenario | Reference |
|----------|-----------|
| Consumer app needing personality | Material 3 |
| Enterprise productivity tool | Fluent 2 |
| Complex data-heavy enterprise | Carbon |
| Custom-styled accessible components | Spectrum (React The Architect) |
| Cross-platform native feel | Fluent 2 |
| Design token best practices | Carbon (granularity) |
| Accessible hooks without styling | Spectrum (React The Architect) |
| Dynamic theming/personalization | Material 3 |

## Issues Encontrados e Corrigidos

### Issue 1: Checkbox missing `disabled:pointer-events-none`

- **Correcao**: Adicionado `disabled:pointer-events-none`
- **Status**: CORRIGIDO

### Issue 4: Sonner missing `data-slot` and `cn()` merge
- **Severidade**: MEDIUM
