```markdown
{{pr_what_description}}

## Why

{{pr_why_description}}

## Type of Change

- [ ] New component
- [ ] Component update
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Token change
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Breaking change

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] Storybook stories added/updated
- [ ] Accessibility tested
- [ ] Visual regression verified
- [ ] Design review approved
- [ ] No hardcoded values (tokens used)

## Screenshots / Recordings

{{pr_screenshots_section}}

## Breaking Changes (if any)

{{pr_breaking_changes_section}}
```

---

## 2. Code Review Checklist

### For Reviewers

- [ ] Component follows atomic design classification
- [ ] Naming conventions are consistent with system standards
- [ ] Props API is consistent with existing components
- [ ] All states are handled (default, hover, focus, active, disabled, error)
- [ ] Accessibility requirements met (keyboard, screen reader, contrast)
- [ ] Design tokens used (no hardcoded colors, spacing, typography)
- [ ] Responsive behavior defined and tested
- [ ] Unit tests cover all props and state changes
- [ ] Documentation is complete and accurate
- [ ] No unnecessary dependencies added
- [ ] Bundle size impact is acceptable (< {{max_bundle_increase}})
- [ ] TypeScript types are properly exported

### Review SLA

| Priority | Response Time | Resolution Time |
|---|---|---|
| Critical (blocking) | {{critical_response}} | {{critical_resolution}} |
| Standard | {{standard_response}} | {{standard_resolution}} |
| Low priority | {{low_response}} | {{low_resolution}} |

## 3. Component Creation Workflow

| Step | Action | Owner | Artifact |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Submit contribution proposal | {{step1_owner}} | Proposal document |
| 2 | Design review and approval | {{step2_owner}} | Approved design |
| 3 | Create component folder structure | {{step3_owner}} | Scaffolded files |
| 4 | Implement component | {{step4_owner}} | Component code |
| 5 | Write unit tests | {{step5_owner}} | Test file |
| 6 | Add Storybook stories | {{step6_owner}} | Story file |
| 7 | Write documentation | {{step7_owner}} | Doc page |
| 8 | Accessibility audit | {{step8_owner}} | Audit report |
| 9 | Code review | {{step9_owner}} | Approved PR |
| 10 | Merge and release | {{step10_owner}} | Published package |

|---|---|---|---|
| Patch | x.x.PATCH | {{patch_frequency}} | {{patch_approval}} |
| Minor | x.MINOR.0 | {{minor_frequency}} | {{minor_approval}} |
| Major | MAJOR.0.0 | {{major_frequency}} | {{major_approval}} |

### Release Steps

2. {{release_step_2}}
3. {{release_step_3}}
4. {{release_step_4}}
5. {{release_step_5}}

- [ ] All tests passing
- [ ] Changelog updated
- [ ] Version bumped
- [ ] Visual regression tests approved
- [ ] Stakeholder sign-off (for major releases)
- [ ] Migration guide written (for breaking changes)
- [ ] Release notes drafted
- [ ] Communication sent to consumers

```yaml
# .state.yaml
# Design System State Tracking
# Brad writes audit/consolidation/tokenization data
# Merovingian reads and writes component building data
# Enables seamless handoff between agents

version: "1.0"
project_name: "{{project_name}}"
created_at: "{{created_timestamp}}"
updated_at: "{{updated_timestamp}}"
tailwind_version: "{{tailwind_version}}"

# Current phase in design system workflow
system_state:
  phase: "{{current_phase}}"  # audit_complete | consolidation_complete | tokenize_complete | migration_strategy_complete | setup_complete | building_components

  # Phase 1: Inventory (Brad)
  inventory:
    scanned_at: "{{scan_timestamp}}"
    scan_path: "{{scan_path}}"
    total_files: {{total_files}}
    frameworks_detected:
      react: {{has_react}}
      vue: {{has_vue}}
      html: {{has_html}}
    patterns:
      buttons:
        unique: {{buttons_unique}}
        instances: {{buttons_instances}}
        redundancy_factor: {{buttons_redundancy}}
      colors:
        unique: {{colors_unique}}
        instances: {{colors_instances}}
        redundancy_factor: {{colors_redundancy}}
      spacing:
        unique_padding: {{spacing_padding}}
        unique_margin: {{spacing_margin}}
      typography:
        unique_fonts: {{typography_fonts}}
        unique_sizes: {{typography_sizes}}
        unique_weights: {{typography_weights}}
      forms:
        unique_inputs: {{forms_inputs}}
        unique_forms: {{forms_forms}}
    estimated_monthly_cost: "{{estimated_cost}}"

  # Phase 2: Consolidation (Brad)
  consolidation:
    completed_at: "{{consolidation_timestamp}}"
    patterns_consolidated:
      colors:
        before: {{colors_before}}
        after: {{colors_after}}
        reduction: "{{colors_reduction}}%"
        clusters: {{colors_clusters}}
      buttons:
        before: {{buttons_before}}
        after: {{buttons_after}}
        reduction: "{{buttons_reduction}}%"
        variants: {{buttons_variants}}
      spacing:
        before: {{spacing_before}}
        after: {{spacing_after}}
        reduction: "{{spacing_reduction}}%"
        scale: {{spacing_scale}}
      typography:
        before: {{typography_before}}
        after: {{typography_after}}
        reduction: "{{typography_reduction}}%"
    overall_reduction: "{{overall_reduction}}%"
    target_met: {{target_met}}
    user_overrides: {{user_overrides}}

  # Phase 3: Tokenization (Brad)
  tokens:
    generated_at: "{{token_timestamp}}"
    version: "{{token_version}}"
    location: "{{token_location}}"
    exports:
      - tokens.yaml
      - tokens.json
      - tokens.css
      - tokens.tailwind.js
      - tokens.scss
      - tokens.dtcg.json
    categories:
      color: {{token_color_count}}
      spacing: {{token_spacing_count}}
      typography: {{token_typography_count}}
      radius: {{token_radius_count}}
      shadow: {{token_shadow_count}}
    total_tokens: {{total_tokens}}
    coverage: "{{token_coverage}}%"
    dtcg_compliant: {{token_dtcg_compliant}}
    color_space: "{{token_color_space}}"

  # Phase 4: ROI Analysis (Brad)
  roi:
    calculated_at: "{{roi_timestamp}}"
    before:
      patterns: {{patterns_before}}
      monthly_cost: {{monthly_cost_before}}
      annual_cost: {{annual_cost_before}}
    after:
      patterns: {{patterns_after}}
      monthly_cost: {{monthly_cost_after}}
      annual_cost: {{annual_cost_after}}
    savings:
      monthly: {{monthly_savings}}
      annual: {{annual_savings}}
    implementation:
      estimated_cost: {{implementation_cost}}
    roi_metrics:
      ratio: {{roi_ratio}}
      breakeven_months: {{breakeven_months}}

  # Phase 5: Migration Strategy (Brad)
  migration:
    strategy_created_at: "{{migration_timestamp}}"
    phases:
      - phase: 1
        name: "Foundation"
        duration_sprints: 1
        status: {{phase1_status}}
      - phase: 2
        name: "High-Impact"
        duration_sprints: 2-3
        priorities: {{phase2_priorities}}
        status: {{phase2_status}}
      - phase: 3
        name: "Long-Tail"
        duration_sprints: 2-4
        status: {{phase3_status}}
      - phase: 4
        name: "Enforcement"
        duration_sprints: 1
        status: {{phase4_status}}
    current_phase: {{current_migration_phase}}
    completion_percentage: {{migration_completion}}
    estimated_completion: "{{migration_completion_date}}"

  # Phase 6: Merovingian Setup
  atlas_setup:
    completed_at: "{{atlas_setup_timestamp}}"
    starting_point: "{{starting_point}}"  # brownfield | greenfield
    configuration:
      component_directory: "{{component_dir}}"
      css_approach: "{{css_approach}}"
      test_framework: "{{test_framework}}"
      storybook_enabled: {{storybook_enabled}}
    tokens_loaded: {{tokens_loaded_success}}

  # Phase 7: Component Building (Merovingian)
  patterns_built:
    atoms:
      total: {{atoms_total}}
      components: {{atoms_list}}
    molecules:
      total: {{molecules_total}}
      components: {{molecules_list}}
    organisms:
      total: {{organisms_total}}
      components: {{organisms_list}}
    templates:
      total: {{templates_total}}
      components: {{templates_list}}

  # Documentation (Merovingian)
  documentation:
    generated_at: "{{docs_timestamp}}"
    components_documented: {{docs_components}}
    pattern_library_location: "{{docs_location}}"

  # Integration (Merovingian)
  integrations:
    mmos:
      status: {{mmos_integration_status}}
      components: {{mmos_components}}
    creator_os:
      status: {{creator_os_integration_status}}
      components: {{creator_os_components}}
    innerlens:
      status: {{innerlens_integration_status}}
      components: {{innerlens_components}}

  tooling:
    tailwind:
      version: "{{tailwind_version}}"
      upgraded_at: "{{tailwind_upgraded_at}}"
      oxide_benchmark:
        full_build_ms: {{tailwind_full_build_ms}}
        incremental_build_us: {{tailwind_incremental_build_us}}
      theme_layers_validated: {{tailwind_theme_validated}}
    design_tokens:
      dtcg_version: "{{dtcg_version}}"
      exports:
        json: {{dtcg_json_path}}
        yaml: {{dtcg_yaml_path}}
      okclh_coverage: "{{oklch_coverage}}"
    shadcn:
      bootstrap_completed_at: "{{shadcn_bootstrap_timestamp}}"
      components_installed: {{shadcn_components}}
    dark_mode:
      enabled: {{dark_mode_enabled}}
      parity_score: "{{dark_mode_parity_score}}"

# Agent execution history (for debugging and handoff)
agent_history:
  - agent: "{{agent_name}}"
    command: "{{command}}"
    timestamp: "{{command_timestamp}}"
    args: {{command_args}}
    status: "{{command_status}}"

# Flags for agent communication
flags:
  ready_for_atlas: {{ready_for_atlas}}
  ready_for_migration: {{ready_for_migration}}
  system_complete: {{system_complete}}
```

```
          |  references  |
+--------------------------------------------------+
|  SEMANTIC / ALIAS TOKENS                          |
|  color-action-primary, color-feedback-error      |
+--------------------------------------------------+
          |  references  |
+--------------------------------------------------+
|  GLOBAL TOKENS (most generic)                    |
|  color-blue-500, spacing-4, font-size-16         |
+--------------------------------------------------+
```

### Tier Rules

| Tier | Who Can Reference | Who Can Modify | Naming Pattern |
|---|---|---|---|
| Global | Semantic tokens only | {{global_modifier}} | `{{global_pattern}}` |
| Semantic | Component tokens, direct use | {{semantic_modifier}} | `{{semantic_pattern}}` |
| Component | Direct use only | {{component_modifier}} | `{{component_pattern}}` |

---

## 2. Category Inventory

| Category | Token Count | Tier Coverage | Example |
|---|---|---|---|
| Color | {{color_count}} | Global + Semantic + Component | `{{color_example}}` |
| Spacing | {{spacing_count}} | Global + Semantic | `{{spacing_example}}` |
| Typography | {{typography_count}} | Global + Semantic + Component | `{{typography_example}}` |
| Border | {{border_count}} | Global + Semantic | `{{border_example}}` |
| Shadow | {{shadow_count}} | Global + Semantic | `{{shadow_example}}` |
| Motion | {{motion_count}} | Global + Semantic | `{{motion_example}}` |
| Opacity | {{opacity_count}} | Global + Semantic | `{{opacity_example}}` |
| Z-Index | {{zindex_count}} | Semantic only | `{{zindex_example}}` |
| Breakpoint | {{breakpoint_count}} | Global only | `{{breakpoint_example}}` |

---

## 3. Naming Convention Rules

### Global Tokens

**Pattern:** `{{global_prefix}}-{category}-{scale/name}`

| Rule | Convention | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Color scale | Numeric 50-950 | `color-blue-500` |
| Spacing scale | Numeric | `spacing-4` |
| Font size | Numeric (px value) | `font-size-16` |
| Font weight | Descriptive | `font-weight-bold` |
| Border radius | Size keyword | `radius-medium` |

### Semantic Tokens

**Pattern:** `{{semantic_prefix}}-{intent}-{property}-{state}`

| Rule | Convention | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Action colors | intent + property | `color-action-background` |
| Feedback colors | feedback + severity | `color-feedback-error` |
| Surface colors | surface + hierarchy | `color-surface-primary` |
| Text colors | text + hierarchy | `color-text-secondary` |

### Component Tokens

**Pattern:** `{{component_prefix}}-{component}-{property}-{variant}-{state}`

| Rule | Convention | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Button tokens | component + property | `button-background-hover` |
| Input tokens | component + property | `input-border-focus` |
| Card tokens | component + property | `card-shadow-elevated` |

```yaml
      inset-md:
        "$value": "{{spacing_md}}"
      inset-lg:
        "$value": "{{spacing_lg}}"

        "$value": "{{spacing_xl}}"
    typography:
      "$type": "typography"

        "$value":

          "$value": "{{color_primary}}"
        background-hover:

        text:

        padding-block:

        background-hover:
          "$value": "{{color_secondary_dark}}"

        "$value": "{{color_neutral_200}}"

        "$value": "{{radius_lg}}"
      padding:
        "$value": "{{spacing_lg}}"
    input:
      "$type": "object"
      background:
        "$value": "{{color_background}}"
      border:
        "$value": "{{color_neutral_300}}"
      border-focus:
        "$value": "{{color_primary}}"
      text:
        "$value": "{{color_text}}"
      placeholder:
        "$value": "{{color_neutral_500}}"

exports:

  json: tokens.json

  dtcg: tokens.dtcg.json
```

## Referência: references/squad/workflows/agentic-readiness.yaml

```yaml
workflow:
  id: design-system-agentic-readiness
  name: Design System Agentic Readiness
  description: Audit and setup machine-readable artifacts so AI agents can safely consume the design system.
  version: 1.0.0
  type: sequential
  sequence:
    - step: step-1-agentic-audit
      id: step-1-agentic-audit
      phase: 1
      phase_name: Audit Agentic Readiness
      agent: brad-frost
      action: agentic-audit
      outputs:
        - report
      next: step-2-agentic-setup
    - step: step-2-agentic-setup
      id: step-2-agentic-setup
      phase: 2
      phase_name: Setup Agentic Foundations
      agent: brad-frost
      action: agentic-setup
      outputs:
        - setup_report
        - metadata_file
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
metadata:
  author: Brad (Design System Architect)
  created_date: "2026-02-17"
  last_modified: "2026-02-17"
  tags:
    - design-system
    - agentic
    - metadata
    - governance
inputs:
  codebase_path:
    type: string
    description: Path to evaluate for agentic readiness
    required: true
  project_name:
    type: string
    description: Project namespace for outputs
    required: true
    default: my-app
steps:
  - id: step_1_agentic_audit
    name: Audit Agentic Readiness
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*agentic-audit"
    inputs:
      path: "{{codebase_path}}"
    outputs:
      report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/agentic/agentic-audit.md
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_2_agentic_setup
    name: Setup Agentic Foundations
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*agentic-setup"
    inputs:
      audit_report: "{{step_1_agentic_audit.report}}"
    outputs:
      setup_report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/agentic/agentic-setup.md
      metadata_file: workspace/domains/design-system/metadata/components.json
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
outputs:
  readiness_complete:
    type: boolean
    source: step_2_agentic_setup.success
  readiness_report:
    type: string
    source: step_2_agentic_setup.setup_report
quality_gates:
  internal_quality_chain:
    required:
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/generate_components_metadata.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/validate_components_metadata.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/sync_design_manifest.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/validate_design_manifest_drift.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/validate_task_checklist_bindings.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/validate_mcp_skeleton.cjs
    optional:
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/test_mcp_tools.cjs
    blocking: true
    policy: internal-first
    exception:
      external_tool_allowed_with:
        - capability_gap_documented
        - rationale_recorded
```


## Referência: references/squad/workflows/audit-only.yaml

```yaml
workflow:
  id: design-system-audit-only
  name: Design System Audit-Only
  description: "Audit-only workflow: scan codebase for UI chaos, generate visual shock report and ROI calculation for stakeholder presentation. Mandatory governance protocol: squads/aiox-design/protocols/ai-first-governance.md"
  version: 2.0.0
  type: sequential
  sequence:
    - step: step-1-audit
      id: step-1-audit
      phase: 1
      phase_name: Audit Codebase for Pattern Redundancy
      agent: brad-frost
      action: audit
      outputs:
        - inventory_report
        - state_file
      next: step-2-consolidate
    - step: step-2-consolidate
      id: step-2-consolidate
      phase: 2
      phase_name: Consolidate Patterns for Metrics
      agent: brad-frost
      action: consolidate
      outputs:
        - consolidation_report
        - reduction_metrics
      next: step-3-shock-report
    - step: step-3-shock-report
      id: step-3-shock-report
      phase: 3
      phase_name: Generate Visual Shock Report
      agent: brad-frost
      action: shock-report
      outputs:
        - shock_report_html
        - shock_report_pdf
        - screenshots
      next: step-4-calculate-roi
    - step: step-4-calculate-roi
      id: step-4-calculate-roi
      phase: 4
      phase_name: Calculate ROI and Cost Savings
      agent: brad-frost
      action: calculate-roi
      outputs:
        - roi_report
        - roi_summary
        - executive_summary
      next: step-5-tokenize-preview
    - step: step-5-tokenize-preview
      id: step-5-tokenize-preview
      phase: 5
      phase_name: Preview Token Recommendations (Optional)
      agent: brad-frost
      action: tokenize
      outputs:
        - token_preview
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
metadata:
  author: Brad (Design System Architect)
  created_date: "2025-10-27"
  last_modified: "2026-02-16"
  tags:
    - design-system
    - audit
    - shock-report
    - roi
    - executive
    - brad
inputs:
  codebase_path:
    type: string
    description: Path to codebase for audit (e.g., ./src)
    required: true
    validation: Must be valid directory path
  project_name:
    type: string
    description: Project name for output organization
    required: true
    default: my-app
  hourly_rate:
    type: number
    description: Developer hourly rate for ROI calculation (USD)
    required: false
    default: 150
  team_size:
    type: number
    description: Number of developers on team
    required: false
    default: 5
steps:
  - id: step_1_audit
    name: Audit Codebase for Pattern Redundancy
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*audit"
    inputs:
      path: "{{codebase_path}}"
    outputs:
      inventory_report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/audit/inventory.yaml
      state_file: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/.state.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_2_consolidate
    name: Consolidate Patterns for Metrics
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*consolidate"
    inputs:
      inventory: "{{step_1_audit.inventory_report}}"
    outputs:
      consolidation_report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/consolidation/decisions.yaml
      reduction_metrics: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/consolidation/metrics.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_3_shock_report
    name: Generate Visual Shock Report
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*shock-report"
    inputs:
      inventory: "{{step_1_audit.inventory_report}}"
      consolidation: "{{step_2_consolidate.consolidation_report}}"
    outputs:
      shock_report_html: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/reports/shock-report.html
      shock_report_pdf: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/reports/shock-report.pdf
      screenshots: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/reports/screenshots/
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_4_calculate_roi
    name: Calculate ROI and Cost Savings
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*calculate-roi"
    inputs:
      consolidation: "{{step_2_consolidate.consolidation_report}}"
      reduction_metrics: "{{step_2_consolidate.reduction_metrics}}"
      hourly_rate: "{{hourly_rate}}"
      team_size: "{{team_size}}"
    outputs:
      roi_report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/reports/roi.yaml
      roi_summary: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/reports/roi-summary.md
      executive_summary: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/reports/executive-summary.pdf
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_5_tokenize_preview
    name: Preview Token Recommendations (Optional)
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*tokenize"
    inputs:
      consolidation: "{{step_2_consolidate.consolidation_report}}"
      preview_mode: true
    outputs:
      token_preview: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/reports/token-preview.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: skip
outputs:
  audit_complete:
    type: boolean
    description: Audit completed successfully
    source: step_4_calculate_roi.success
  shock_report_location:
    type: string
    description: Path to visual shock report (HTML)
    source: step_3_shock_report.shock_report_html
  roi_summary_location:
    type: string
    description: Path to ROI summary (Markdown)
    source: step_4_calculate_roi.roi_summary
  executive_summary_location:
    type: string
    description: Path to executive summary (PDF)
    source: step_4_calculate_roi.executive_summary
  pattern_count_before:
    type: number
    description: Total patterns before consolidation
    source: step_2_consolidate.reduction_metrics.before
  pattern_count_after:
    type: number
    description: Recommended patterns after consolidation
    source: step_2_consolidate.reduction_metrics.after
  reduction_percentage:
    type: number
    description: Pattern reduction percentage
    source: step_2_consolidate.reduction_metrics.reduction_percent
  annual_savings_usd:
    type: number
    description: Projected annual cost savings (USD)
    source: step_4_calculate_roi.roi_report.annual_savings
  roi_ratio:
    type: number
    description: ROI ratio (savings/investment)
    source: step_4_calculate_roi.roi_report.roi_ratio
  breakeven_days:
    type: number
    description: Days to breakeven
    source: step_4_calculate_roi.roi_report.breakeven_days
global_error_handling:
  on_error: abort
  notification:
    enabled: true
    channels:
      - console
security:
  authorization_required: false
  audit_logging: true
quality_gates:
  internal_quality_chain:
    required:
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/generate_components_metadata.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/validate_components_metadata.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/sync_design_manifest.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/validate_design_manifest_drift.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/validate_task_checklist_bindings.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/validate_mcp_skeleton.cjs
    optional:
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/test_mcp_tools.cjs
    blocking: true
    policy: internal-first
    exception:
      external_tool_allowed_with:
        - capability_gap_documented
        - rationale_recorded
```

```yaml
workflow:
  id: design-system-brownfield-complete
  name: Design System Brownfield Complete
  description: "Complete workflow for brownfield projects: audit UI chaos, consolidate patterns, extract tokens, plan migration, then build production components. Mandatory governance protocol: squads/aiox-design/protocols/ai-first-governance.md"
  version: 2.0.0
  type: sequential
  sequence:
    - step: step-1-audit
      id: step-1-audit
      phase: 1
      phase_name: Audit Codebase for Pattern Redundancy
      agent: brad-frost
      action: audit
      outputs:
        - inventory_report
        - state_file
      next: step-2-consolidate
    - step: step-2-consolidate
      id: step-2-consolidate
      phase: 2
      phase_name: Consolidate Patterns Using Clustering
      agent: brad-frost
      action: consolidate
      outputs:
        - consolidation_report
        - reduction_metrics
      next: step-3-tokenize
    - step: step-3-tokenize
      id: step-3-tokenize
      phase: 3
      phase_name: Extract Design Tokens
      agent: brad-frost
      action: tokenize
      outputs:
        - tokens_yaml
        - tokens_json
        - tokens_css
        - tokens_tailwind
      next: step-4-migrate
    - step: step-4-migrate
      id: step-4-migrate
      phase: 4
      phase_name: Generate Migration Strategy
      agent: brad-frost
      action: migrate
      outputs:
        - migration_plan
      next: step-5-shock-report
    - step: step-5-shock-report
      id: step-5-shock-report
      phase: 5
      phase_name: Generate Shock Report (Optional)
      agent: brad-frost
      action: shock-report
      outputs:
        - shock_report
      next: step-6-calculate-roi
    - step: step-6-calculate-roi
      id: step-6-calculate-roi
      phase: 6
      phase_name: Calculate ROI (Optional)
      agent: brad-frost
      action: calculate-roi
      outputs:
        - roi_report
      next: step-7-build-atoms
    - step: step-7-build-atoms
      id: step-7-build-atoms
      phase: 7
      phase_name: Build Atomic Components
      agent: brad-frost
      action: build
      outputs:
        - components
      next: step-8-compose-molecules
    - step: step-8-compose-molecules
      id: step-8-compose-molecules
      phase: 8
      phase_name: Compose Molecule Components
      agent: brad-frost
      action: compose
      outputs:
        - molecules
      next: step-9-document
    - step: step-9-document
      id: step-9-document
      phase: 9
      phase_name: Generate Pattern Library Documentation
      agent: brad-frost
      action: document
      outputs:
        - documentation
        - storybook
      next: step-9b-motion-quality
    - step: step-9b-motion-quality
      id: step-9b-motion-quality
      phase: 9.5
      phase_name: Apply Kinetic Motion Layer (Optional)
      agent: brad-frost
      action: workflow
      workflow: motion-quality
      optional: true
      condition: "brand_personality is set OR reference_url is set"
      outputs:
        - motion_tokens
        - motion_primitives
        - motion_map
      next: step-10-promote-to-workspace
    - step: step-10-promote-to-workspace
      id: step-10-promote-to-workspace
      phase: 10
      phase_name: Promote Outputs to Workspace Canonical Locations
      agent: brad-frost
      action: sync-registry
      outputs:
        - tokens_promoted
        - registry_updated
        - metadata_updated
      next: step-11-critical-eye
    - step: step-11-critical-eye
      id: step-11-critical-eye
      phase: 11
      phase_name: Run Critical Eye Curation Cycle
      agent: brad-frost
      action: workflow
      outputs:
        - catalog_updated
        - cycle_report
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
metadata:
  author: Brad (Design System Architect)
  created_date: "2025-10-27"
  last_modified: "2026-03-23"
  tags:
    - design-system
    - brownfield
    - audit
    - consolidation
    - components
    - brad
inputs:
  codebase_path:
    type: string
    description: Path to codebase for audit (e.g., ./src)
    required: true
    validation: Must be valid directory path
  project_name:
    type: string
    description: Project name for output organization
    required: true
    default: my-app
  reference_url:
    type: string
    description: URL to extract animations from (for motion-quality sub-workflow Phase 4)
    required: false
  brand_personality:
    type: string
    description: "Motion personality: playful | professional | minimal | dramatic (for motion-quality sub-workflow)"
    required: false
    default: professional
steps:
  - id: step_1_audit
    name: Audit Codebase for Pattern Redundancy
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*audit"
    inputs:
      path: "{{codebase_path}}"
    outputs:
      inventory_report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/audit/inventory.yaml
      state_file: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/.state.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_2_consolidate
    name: Consolidate Patterns Using Clustering
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*consolidate"
    inputs:
      inventory: "{{step_1_audit.inventory_report}}"
    outputs:
      consolidation_report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/consolidation/decisions.yaml
      reduction_metrics: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/consolidation/metrics.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_3_tokenize
    name: Extract Design Tokens
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*tokenize"
    inputs:
      consolidation: "{{step_2_consolidate.consolidation_report}}"
    outputs:
      tokens_yaml: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/tokens/tokens.yaml
      tokens_json: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/tokens/tokens.json
      tokens_css: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/tokens/tokens.css
      tokens_tailwind: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/tokens/tokens.tailwind.js
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_4_migrate
    name: Generate Migration Strategy
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*migrate"
    inputs:
      tokens: "{{step_3_tokenize.tokens_yaml}}"
      consolidation: "{{step_2_consolidate.consolidation_report}}"
    outputs:
      migration_plan: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/migration/plan.md
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_5_shock_report
    name: Generate Shock Report (Optional)
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*shock-report"
    inputs:
      inventory: "{{step_1_audit.inventory_report}}"
      consolidation: "{{step_2_consolidate.consolidation_report}}"
    outputs:
      shock_report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/reports/shock-report.html
    error_handling:
      strategy: skip
  - id: step_6_calculate_roi
    name: Calculate ROI (Optional)
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*calculate-roi"
    inputs:
      consolidation: "{{step_2_consolidate.consolidation_report}}"
    outputs:
      roi_report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/reports/roi.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: skip
  - id: step_7_build_atoms
    name: Build Atomic Components
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*build"
    inputs:
      tokens: "{{step_3_tokenize.tokens_yaml}}"
      patterns: button,input,label,icon
    outputs:
      components: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/components/atoms/
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_8_compose_molecules
    name: Compose Molecule Components
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*compose"
    inputs:
      atoms: "{{step_7_build_atoms.components}}"
      patterns: form-field,card,alert
    outputs:
      molecules: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/components/molecules/
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_9_document
    name: Generate Pattern Library Documentation
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*document"
    inputs:
      components: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/components/
      tokens: "{{step_3_tokenize.tokens_yaml}}"
    outputs:
      documentation: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/docs/
      storybook: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/.storybook/
    error_handling:
      strategy: skip
  - id: step_9b_motion_quality
    name: Apply Kinetic Motion Layer (Optional)
    type: workflow
    agent: brad-frost
    workflow: motion-quality
    description: >
      Invoke the motion-quality sub-workflow to apply the Kinetic Design System
      motion layer. Runs only when brand_personality or reference_url are provided.
      Non-blocking: motion failure does not halt the brownfield pipeline.
    optional: true
    condition: "{{brand_personality}} is set OR {{reference_url}} is set"
    inputs:
      codebase_path: "{{codebase_path}}"
      project_name: "{{project_name}}"
      reference_url: "{{reference_url}}"
      brand_personality: "{{brand_personality}}"
    outputs:
      motion_tokens: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/motion/motion-tokens.css
      motion_primitives: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/motion/motion-primitives.css
      motion_map: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/motion/motion-map.json
    error_handling:
      strategy: skip
  - id: step_10_promote_to_workspace
    name: Promote Outputs to Workspace Canonical Locations
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*sync-registry"
    description: Move outputs from outputs/ to workspace canonical paths
    inputs:
      tokens_source: "{{step_3_tokenize.tokens_yaml}}"
      components_source: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/components/
    outputs:
      tokens_promoted: workspace/system/tokens/
      registry_updated: workspace/ui/registry.json
      metadata_updated: workspace/domains/design-system/metadata/components.json
    promotion_map:
      - from: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/tokens/tokens.json
        to: workspace/system/tokens/primitive.tokens.json
      - from: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/tokens/tokens.yaml
        to: squads/aiox-design/data/design-tokens-spec.yaml
      - from: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/components/
        to: workspace/ui/components/
    validation:
      - workspace/ui/registry.json updated with new components
      - workspace/domains/design-system/metadata/components.json reflects changes
      - squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/validate_components_metadata.cjs passes
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_11_critical_eye
    name: Run Critical Eye Curation Cycle
    type: workflow
    agent: brad-frost
    workflow: critical-eye
    description: Evaluate all promoted patterns through the Critical Eye scoring engine. Scores variants (0-100), applies lifecycle transitions, generates proposals for canonical promotion. Non-blocking — brownfield completes even if curation is skipped.
    inputs:
      catalog: workspace/ui/pattern-catalog.json
      scoring_rules: squads/aiox-design/data/critical-eye-scoring-rules.yaml
      decisions_log: workspace/ui/canonical-decisions.json
    outputs:
      catalog_updated: workspace/ui/pattern-catalog.json
      cycle_report: outputs/design-system/critical-eye/cycle-{{cycle_number}}/report.md
    error_handling:
      strategy: skip
outputs:
  design_system_complete:
    type: boolean
    description: Workflow completed successfully
    source: step_10_promote_to_workspace.success
  tokens_location:
    type: string
    description: Path to design tokens
    source: step_3_tokenize.tokens_yaml
  components_location:
    type: string
    description: Path to generated components
    source: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/components/
  migration_plan_location:
    type: string
    description: Path to migration plan
    source: step_4_migrate.migration_plan
  shock_report_location:
    type: string
    description: Path to shock report (if generated)
    source: step_5_shock_report.shock_report
  roi_metrics:
    type: string
    description: ROI calculation results
    source: step_6_calculate_roi.roi_report
global_error_handling:
  on_error: abort
  notification:
    enabled: true
    channels:
      - console
security:
  authorization_required: false
  audit_logging: true
quality_gates:
  internal_quality_chain:
    required:
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/generate_components_metadata.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/validate_components_metadata.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/sync_design_manifest.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/validate_design_manifest_drift.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/validate_task_checklist_bindings.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/validate_mcp_skeleton.cjs
    optional:
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/test_mcp_tools.cjs
    blocking: true
    policy: internal-first
    exception:
      external_tool_allowed_with:
        - capability_gap_documented
        - rationale_recorded
```


## Referência: references/squad/workflows/critical-eye.yaml

```yaml
workflow:
  id: design-system-critical-eye
  name: Critical Eye — Continuous DS Curation
  description: "Recurring workflow that evaluates all pattern variants across categories, scores them (0-100), and promotes/demotes through lifecycle states (CANDIDATE → EXPERIMENTAL → STABLE → CANONICAL → DEPRECATED). Runs after each extraction cycle. Mandatory governance protocol: squads/aiox-design/protocols/ai-first-governance.md"
  version: 1.0.0
  type: sequential
  sequence:
    - step: step-1-inventory
      id: step-1-inventory
      phase: 1
      phase_name: Inventory All Variants Per Category
      agent: brad-frost
      action: ds-critical-eye-inventory
      outputs:
        - inventory
      next: step-2-score
    - step: step-2-score
      id: step-2-score
      phase: 2
      phase_name: Score Each Variant Using 5 Dimensions
      agent: brad-frost
      action: ds-critical-eye-score
      outputs:
        - scored_variants
      next: step-3-compare
    - step: step-3-compare
      id: step-3-compare
      phase: 3
      phase_name: Compare and Rank Variants Within Category
      agent: brad-frost
      action: ds-critical-eye-compare
      outputs:
        - rankings
      next: step-4-decide
    - step: step-4-decide
      id: step-4-decide
      phase: 4
      phase_name: Make Lifecycle Transition Decisions
      agent: brad-frost
      action: ds-critical-eye-decide
      outputs:
        - decisions
        - proposals
        - updated_catalog
        - updated_decisions_log
      next: step-5-review
    - step: step-5-review
      id: step-5-review
      phase: 5
      phase_name: Human Review for Canonical Promotions
      agent: design-chief
      action: ds-critical-eye-review-checklist
      outputs:
        - review_decisions
      next: step-6-report
    - step: step-6-report
      id: step-6-report
      phase: 6
      phase_name: Generate Cycle Report
      agent: brad-frost
      action: ds-critical-eye-report
      outputs:
        - report
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
  handoff_prompts:
    brad-frost_to_design-chief: Handoff context from brad-frost to design-chief. Preserve outputs, risks, and open decisions.
    design-chief_to_brad-frost: Handoff context from design-chief to brad-frost. Preserve outputs, risks, and open decisions.
metadata:
  author: Brad Frost (Design System Architect)
  created_date: "2026-02-18"
  last_modified: "2026-02-18"
  tags:
    - design-system
    - curation
    - critical-eye
    - scoring
    - lifecycle
    - governance
    - brad
inputs:
  catalog_path:
    type: string
    description: Path to the pattern catalog JSON
    required: true
    default: workspace/ui/pattern-catalog.json
  scoring_rules_path:
    type: string
    description: Path to the scoring rules YAML
    required: true
    default: squads/aiox-design/data/critical-eye-scoring-rules.yaml
  decisions_log_path:
    type: string
    description: Path to the append-only decisions log
    required: true
    default: workspace/ui/canonical-decisions.json
  cycle_number:
    type: integer
    description: Current evaluation cycle (auto-incremented from catalog.evaluationCycle)
    required: false
  categories_filter:
    type: array
    description: "Optional: evaluate only specific categories (empty = all)"
    required: false
    default: []
steps:
  - id: step_1_inventory
    name: Inventory All Variants Per Category
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    task: ds-critical-eye-inventory
    description: Scan pattern-catalog.json and group all variants by category. Detect new variants from latest extraction. Cross-reference with registry.json and metadata.
    inputs:
      catalog: "{{catalog_path}}"
      categories_filter: "{{categories_filter}}"
    outputs:
      inventory: outputs/design-system/critical-eye/cycle-{{cycle_number}}/inventory.json
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_2_score
    name: Score Each Variant Using 5 Dimensions
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    task: ds-critical-eye-score
    description: Apply scoring engine (breadth 25 + quality 30 + consistency 20 + maturity 15 + simplicity 10 = 100) to every variant. Check a11y blocker (score=0 → auto-REJECT).
    inputs:
      inventory: "{{step_1_inventory.inventory}}"
      scoring_rules: "{{scoring_rules_path}}"
    outputs:
      scored_variants: outputs/design-system/critical-eye/cycle-{{cycle_number}}/scored.json
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_3_compare
    name: Compare and Rank Variants Within Category
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    task: ds-critical-eye-compare
    description: Within each category, rank variants by total score. Apply tiebreaker rule (breadth wins within 10% margin). Identify top candidate per category.
    inputs:
      scored_variants: "{{step_2_score.scored_variants}}"
      scoring_rules: "{{scoring_rules_path}}"
    outputs:
      rankings: outputs/design-system/critical-eye/cycle-{{cycle_number}}/rankings.json
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_4_decide
    name: Make Lifecycle Transition Decisions
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    task: ds-critical-eye-decide
    description: Apply lifecycle transition rules. Auto-transitions (CANDIDATE→EXPERIMENTAL, EXPERIMENTAL→STABLE) execute immediately. Checkpoint transitions (STABLE→CANONICAL, CANONICAL→DEPRECATED) generate proposals for design-chief review.
    inputs:
      rankings: "{{step_3_compare.rankings}}"
      catalog: "{{catalog_path}}"
      decisions_log: "{{decisions_log_path}}"
    outputs:
      decisions: outputs/design-system/critical-eye/cycle-{{cycle_number}}/decisions.json
      proposals: outputs/design-system/critical-eye/cycle-{{cycle_number}}/proposals.json
      updated_catalog: "{{catalog_path}}"
      updated_decisions_log: "{{decisions_log_path}}"
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_5_review
    name: Human Review for Canonical Promotions
    type: checkpoint
    agent: design-chief
    task: ds-critical-eye-review-checklist
    description: Design Chief reviews proposals for STABLE→CANONICAL and CANONICAL→DEPRECATED transitions. Uses review checklist. Required only when proposals exist.
    condition: "{{step_4_decide.proposals}} is not empty"
    inputs:
      proposals: "{{step_4_decide.proposals}}"
      rankings: "{{step_3_compare.rankings}}"
    outputs:
      review_decisions: outputs/design-system/critical-eye/cycle-{{cycle_number}}/review-decisions.json
    error_handling:
      strategy: wait
  - id: step_6_report
    name: Generate Cycle Report
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    task: ds-critical-eye-report
    description: "Compile comprehensive cycle report: summary stats, all scores, transitions executed, proposals pending, category health."
    inputs:
      inventory: "{{step_1_inventory.inventory}}"
      scored_variants: "{{step_2_score.scored_variants}}"
      rankings: "{{step_3_compare.rankings}}"
      decisions: "{{step_4_decide.decisions}}"
      review_decisions: "{{step_5_review.review_decisions}}"
      cycle_number: "{{cycle_number}}"
    outputs:
      report: outputs/design-system/critical-eye/cycle-{{cycle_number}}/report.md
    error_handling:
      strategy: skip
outputs:
  cycle_complete:
    type: boolean
    description: Critical Eye cycle completed successfully
    source: step_6_report.success
  catalog_updated:
    type: string
    description: Updated pattern catalog with new scores and lifecycle states
    source: "{{catalog_path}}"
  decisions_logged:
    type: string
    description: Append-only decisions log with new entries
    source: "{{decisions_log_path}}"
  report_location:
    type: string
    description: Path to the cycle report
    source: step_6_report.report
  pending_proposals:
    type: integer
    description: Number of proposals awaiting human review
    source: step_4_decide.proposals.length
global_error_handling:
  on_error: abort
  notification:
    enabled: true
    channels:
      - console
security:
  authorization_required: false
  audit_logging: true
```

```yaml
workflow:

metadata:

      tokens_file: "{{step_1_extract_w3c_tokens.dtcg_tokens}}"

      token_modes: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/tokens/modes.tokens.json
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
outputs:
  dtcg_complete:

    source: step_1_extract_w3c_tokens.dtcg_tokens
```

## Referência: references/squad/workflows/epic-ds-alignment.yaml

```yaml
workflow:
  id: epic-ds-alignment
  name: Epic Design System Alignment
  description: |
    Quality gate workflow that validates epics with UI/frontend stories against the existing
    Design System. Catches component duplication, token gaps, missing blueprint references,
    routing errors, and DS workflow disconnects BEFORE stories are drafted.

    This workflow is framework-agnostic. It resolves DS context via BU/app first, then scans
    the configured implementation paths for components, tokens, themes, and blueprints.
  version: 1.3.0
  type: sequential
  sequence:
    - step: step-0-resolve-config
      id: step-0-resolve-config
      phase: 1
      phase_name: Resolve — Auto-Discover DS Configuration
      agent: design-chief
      action: resolve-ds-business-slug-or-app-id
      outputs:
        - resolved_config
        - status
        - business_slug
        - app_root
        - component_dirs
        - token_files
        - blueprint_pages
        - framework
      next: step-1-triage
    - step: step-1-triage
      id: step-1-triage
      phase: 2
      phase_name: Triage — Classify Epic for DS Review
      agent: design-chief
      action: design-triage
      outputs:
        - triage_result
      next: step-1b-applicability-gate
    - step: step-1b-applicability-gate
      id: step-1b-applicability-gate
      phase: 3
      phase_name: Gate — DS Applicability
      agent: aiox-master
      action: checkpoint
      next: step-2-component-scan
    - step: step-2-component-scan
      id: step-2-component-scan
      phase: 4
      phase_name: Scan — Inventory Existing Components
      agent: brad-frost
      action: audit
      outputs:
        - component_inventory
      next: step-3-token-scan
    - step: step-3-token-scan
      id: step-3-token-scan
      phase: 5
      phase_name: Scan — Map Available Tokens, Animations, Patterns
      agent: brad-frost
      action: tokenize
      outputs:
        - token_map
        - animation_map
        - pattern_map
      next: step-4-reference-audit
    - step: step-4-reference-audit
      id: step-4-reference-audit
      phase: 6
      phase_name: Audit — Analyze Reference Implementation (conditional)
      agent: brad-frost
      action: audit
      outputs:
        - reference_audit
      next: step-5-cross-reference
    - step: step-5-cross-reference
      id: step-5-cross-reference
      phase: 7
      phase_name: Cross-Reference — Diff Epic vs Inventory
      agent: design-chief
      action: review-epic-ds
      outputs:
        - diff_report
        - coverage_gaps
      next: step-6-checklist
    - step: step-6-checklist
      id: step-6-checklist
      phase: 8
      phase_name: Score — Execute DS Alignment Checklist
      agent: design-chief
      action: execute-checklist-epic-ds-alignment-checklist
      outputs:
        - checklist_result
        - verdict
      next: step-7-verdict-gate
    - step: step-7-verdict-gate
      id: step-7-verdict-gate
      phase: 9
      phase_name: Gate — Verdict Decision
      agent: aiox-master
      action: checkpoint
      next: step-8-auto-fix
    - step: step-8-auto-fix
      id: step-8-auto-fix
      phase: 10
      phase_name: Fix — Auto-Correct Gaps in EPIC.md
      agent: design-chief
      action: review-epic-ds-fix
      outputs:
        - fixed_epic
        - fix_log
        - updated_verdict
      next: step-9-report
    - step: step-9-report
      id: step-9-report
      phase: 11
      phase_name: Report — Generate DS Review Report
      agent: design-chief
      action: review-epic-ds-report
      outputs:
        - review_report
        - updated_epic
      next: step-10-handoff
    - step: step-10-handoff
      id: step-10-handoff
      phase: 12
      phase_name: Handoff — Route to Next Agent
      agent: aiox-master
      action: checkpoint
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
  handoff_prompts:
    design-chief_to_aiox-master: Handoff context from design-chief to aiox-master. Preserve outputs, risks, and open decisions.
    aiox-master_to_brad-frost: Handoff context from aiox-master to brad-frost. Preserve outputs, risks, and open decisions.
    brad-frost_to_design-chief: Handoff context from brad-frost to design-chief. Preserve outputs, risks, and open decisions.
    aiox-master_to_design-chief: Handoff context from aiox-master to design-chief. Preserve outputs, risks, and open decisions.
metadata:
  author: Design Chief
  created_date: "2026-03-08"
  tags:
    - epic
    - design-system
    - alignment
    - quality-gate
    - brownfield
    - review
execution_modes:
  - mode: yolo
    description: Automated scan + auto-fix, minimal prompts
    prompts: 0-1
    default: false
  - mode: interactive
    description: Scan with confirmations at key decisions
    prompts: 3-5
    default: true
  - mode: preflight
    description: Full review with discussion at each phase
    prompts: 5-10
    default: false
inputs:
  epic_path:
    type: string
    description: Path to EPIC.md file
    required: true
    validation: Must be valid file path ending in .md
  business_slug:
    type: string
    description: Business slug matching workspace/workspace.yaml -> businesses.{slug}. Preferred.
    required: false
    default: null
    examples:
      - my_business
      - another_brand
  app_id:
    type: string
    description: App identifier declared inside workspace/businesses/{bu}/design-system/config.yaml.
    required: false
    default: null
    examples:
      - site-main
      - platform-app
      - brandbook
  codebase_path:
    type: string
    description: Path to target app's component directory. Optional if app_id is provided.
    required: false
    validation: Must be valid directory containing components
  reference_path:
    type: string
    description: Path to reference implementation being ported (if migrating)
    required: false
    default: null
  auto_fix:
    type: boolean
    description: Enable auto-fix for GAPS verdict (max 2 iterations)
    required: false
    default: true
  max_fix_iterations:
    type: integer
    description: Maximum auto-fix iterations before escalating
    required: false
    default: 2
steps:
  - id: step_0_resolve_config
    name: Resolve — Auto-Discover DS Configuration
    type: agent
    agent: design-chief
    command: "*resolve-ds {business_slug_or_app_id}"
    description: |
      Resolve DS context through the canonical workspace resolver.
      Resolution order:
      1. If business_slug provided → run squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/resolve_business_design_system.cjs --bu={slug}
      2. If app_id provided → resolve BU via squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/resolve_business_design_system.cjs --app={id}
      3. If no BU/app available → heuristic scan of codebase_path for common patterns

      If the BU is configured, load workspace/businesses/{bu}/design-system/config.yaml and
      resolve: source, themes, component_dirs, token_files, blueprint files, routing, framework,
      ui_primitives, and constraints.

      If the BU is not_applicable, skip DS review and do not request DS creation.
      If the BU is not_configured, stop and return remediation.
    inputs:
      business_slug: "{{business_slug}}"
      app_id: "{{app_id}}"
      codebase_path: "{{codebase_path}}"
    outputs:
      resolved_config: outputs/design-system/epic-review/resolved-config.yaml
      status: configured|not_configured|not_applicable
      business_slug: resolved business slug
      app_root: resolved app root path
      component_dirs: resolved component directories
      token_files: resolved token file paths
      blueprint_pages: resolved catalog/blueprint pages
      framework: resolved framework name
      ui_primitives: resolved UI primitives library
      token_prefix: resolved token naming prefix
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_1_triage
    name: Triage — Classify Epic for DS Review
    type: task
    agent: design-chief
    task: design-triage
    description: Determine if epic has UI/frontend work that requires DS alignment review
    inputs:
      request: Review epic at {{epic_path}} for design system alignment
      context: Epic with UI stories targeting business={{business_slug}} app={{app_id}} codebase={{codebase_path}}
    outputs:
      triage_result: outputs/design-system/epic-review/triage.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
    post_condition: triage_result.scope == 'in_scope'
    skip_message: Epic has no UI work — DS review not needed
  - id: step_1b_applicability_gate
    name: Gate — DS Applicability
    type: checkpoint
    description: |
      Respect the BU DS status before scanning:
      - configured: continue to DS review
      - not_applicable: skip DS review entirely
      - not_configured: stop and return remediation to configure the BU DS
    inputs:
      status: "{{step_0_resolve_config.status}}"
    decision:
      configured:
        next: step_2_component_scan
        message: BU/app has configured DS. Continuing.
      not_applicable:
        next: step_10_handoff
        message: BU DS is not applicable. Skip DS review.
      not_configured:
        next: step_9_report
        message: BU requires DS configuration before epic review can continue.
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_2_component_scan
    name: Scan — Inventory Existing Components
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*audit"
    description: |
      Scan the target codebase for all existing components across the resolved
      component directories (from workspace/businesses/{bu}/design-system/config.yaml).
      Build a full inventory with component names, paths, props, and variants.
    inputs:
      path: "{{step_0_resolve_config.app_root}}"
      subdirs: "{{step_0_resolve_config.component_dirs}}"
    outputs:
      component_inventory: outputs/design-system/epic-review/component-inventory.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_3_token_scan
    name: Scan — Map Available Tokens, Animations, Patterns
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*tokenize"
    description: |
      Extract all available design tokens from the resolved token files
      (from workspace/businesses/{bu}/design-system/config.yaml). Map CSS keyframes,
      transition classes, pattern classes, easing tokens, and duration tokens.
    inputs:
      files: "{{step_0_resolve_config.token_files}}"
    outputs:
      token_map: outputs/design-system/epic-review/token-map.yaml
      animation_map: outputs/design-system/epic-review/animation-map.yaml
      pattern_map: outputs/design-system/epic-review/pattern-map.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_4_reference_audit
    name: Audit — Analyze Reference Implementation (conditional)
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*audit"
    description: |
      If a reference implementation exists, audit it for DO/DON'T patterns,
      edge cases, a11y gaps, and performance issues. Extract lessons learned.
    condition: "{{reference_path}} != null"
    inputs:
      path: "{{reference_path}}"
    outputs:
      reference_audit: outputs/design-system/epic-review/reference-audit.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: skip
  - id: step_5_cross_reference
    name: Cross-Reference — Diff Epic vs Inventory
    type: agent
    agent: design-chief
    command: "*review-epic-ds"
    description: |
      Parse the EPIC.md and cross-reference every proposed component against the
      scanned inventory. Identify: duplicates (components that already exist),
      adaptable (exist but need modification), and truly new (gap to fill).
      Also cross-reference token usage, animation strategy, and pattern assignments.
    inputs:
      epic: "{{epic_path}}"
      inventory: "{{step_2_component_scan.component_inventory}}"
      tokens: "{{step_3_token_scan.token_map}}"
      animations: "{{step_3_token_scan.animation_map}}"
      patterns: "{{step_3_token_scan.pattern_map}}"
      reference: "{{step_4_reference_audit.reference_audit}}"
    outputs:
      diff_report: outputs/design-system/epic-review/component-diff.yaml
      coverage_gaps: outputs/design-system/epic-review/coverage-gaps.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_6_checklist
    name: Score — Execute DS Alignment Checklist
    type: agent
    agent: design-chief
    command: "*execute-checklist epic-ds-alignment-checklist"
    description: |
      Score the epic against the 52-point DS alignment checklist.
      7 sections: Component Inventory (12), Token Coverage (10), Reference Analysis (8),
      Architecture (6), DS Workflow (6), Accessibility (6), Dependencies (4).
      Check section minimums. Determine verdict.
    inputs:
      epic: "{{epic_path}}"
      diff: "{{step_5_cross_reference.diff_report}}"
      gaps: "{{step_5_cross_reference.coverage_gaps}}"
    outputs:
      checklist_result: outputs/design-system/epic-review/checklist-result.yaml
      verdict: outputs/design-system/epic-review/verdict.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_7_verdict_gate
    name: Gate — Verdict Decision
    type: checkpoint
    description: |
      Based on checklist score, determine next action:
      - ALIGNED (>=85%): Proceed to report
      - GAPS (70-84%): Proceed to auto-fix if enabled, else report
      - MISALIGNED (60-69%): Proceed to report with remediation
      - FAIL (<60%): Proceed to report with escalation
    inputs:
      verdict: "{{step_6_checklist.verdict}}"
      auto_fix: "{{auto_fix}}"
    decision:
      ALIGNED:
        next: step_9_report
        message: Epic is DS-aligned. Proceeding to report.
      GAPS:
        next: step_8_auto_fix
        condition: "{{auto_fix}} == true"
        fallback: step_9_report
        message: Gaps found. Attempting auto-fix.
      MISALIGNED:
        next: step_9_report
        message: Epic misaligned with DS. Generating remediation report.
      FAIL:
        next: step_9_report
        message: Epic fails DS alignment. Major rework required.
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_8_auto_fix
    name: Fix — Auto-Correct Gaps in EPIC.md
    type: agent
    agent: design-chief
    command: "*review-epic-ds --fix"
    description: |
      For GAPS verdict, attempt to auto-fix the EPIC.md:
      1. Add missing component inventory section
      2. Add token mapping references
      3. Add DS commands per story
      4. Add color scheme alternation mapping
      5. Re-run checklist (up to max_fix_iterations)

      Non-auto-fixable items (architecture, scope, wave structure) are
      reported as remaining gaps for @pm to address.
    inputs:
      epic: "{{epic_path}}"
      gaps: "{{step_5_cross_reference.coverage_gaps}}"
      inventory: "{{step_2_component_scan.component_inventory}}"
      tokens: "{{step_3_token_scan.token_map}}"
      max_iterations: "{{max_fix_iterations}}"
    outputs:
      fixed_epic: "{{epic_path}}"
      fix_log: outputs/design-system/epic-review/auto-fix-log.yaml
      updated_verdict: outputs/design-system/epic-review/verdict-post-fix.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
    loop:
      max: "{{max_fix_iterations}}"
      exit_on: verdict == ALIGNED
      escalate_on: iteration == max AND verdict != ALIGNED
      escalate_to: MISALIGNED
  - id: step_9_report
    name: Report — Generate DS Review Report
    type: agent
    agent: design-chief
    command: "*review-epic-ds --report"
    description: |
      Generate the final review report and write it to the epic directory.
      Update the EPIC.md revision log with the review verdict.
      Communicate next action to appropriate agent.
    inputs:
      epic: "{{epic_path}}"
      checklist: "{{step_6_checklist.checklist_result}}"
      verdict: "{{step_6_checklist.verdict}}"
      diff: "{{step_5_cross_reference.diff_report}}"
      fix_log: "{{step_8_auto_fix.fix_log}}"
    outputs:
      review_report: docs/stories/epics/{{epic_id}}/ds-review.md
      updated_epic: "{{epic_path}}"
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_10_handoff
    name: Handoff — Route to Next Agent
    type: checkpoint
    description: |
      Based on final verdict, handoff to the appropriate agent:
      - ALIGNED: @sm for story drafting
      - GAPS (post-fix): @pm to address remaining gaps
      - MISALIGNED: @pm with detailed remediation
      - FAIL: @pm + @design-chief joint review
    inputs:
      verdict: "{{step_9_report.final_verdict}}"
    decision:
      ALIGNED:
        handoff_to: "@sm"
        message: Epic DS-aligned. Ready for story drafting.
        action: "*draft"
      GAPS:
        handoff_to: "@pm"
        message: Remaining gaps after auto-fix. Address non-auto-fixable items.
        action: Review ds-review.md and fix listed gaps
      MISALIGNED:
        handoff_to: "@pm"
        message: Epic misaligned. Remediation report generated.
        action: Major revisions needed per ds-review.md
      FAIL:
        handoff_to: "@pm"
        escalate: "@design-chief"
        message: Epic fails DS alignment. Joint review required.
        action: Schedule @pm + @design-chief review session
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
outputs:
  verdict:
    type: string
    description: Final alignment verdict
    source: "{{step_6_checklist.verdict}}"
  score:
    type: object
    description: Detailed scoring breakdown
    source: "{{step_6_checklist.checklist_result}}"
  review_report:
    type: string
    description: Path to generated review report
    source: "{{step_9_report.review_report}}"
  component_diff:
    type: object
    description: Proposed vs existing components diff
    source: "{{step_5_cross_reference.diff_report}}"
  next_agent:
    type: string
    description: Agent to handoff to based on verdict
    source: "{{step_10_handoff.handoff_to}}"
global_error_handling:
  on_error: abort
  notification:
    enabled: true
    channels:
      - console
security:
  authorization_required: false
  audit_logging: true
quality_gates:
  ds_alignment_gate:
    checklist: squads/aiox-design/checklists/epic-ds-alignment-checklist.md
    threshold: 70%
    section_minimums:
      component_inventory: 8
      token_coverage: 6
      architecture: 4
    blocking: true
    verdict_mapping:
      ALIGNED: proceed
      GAPS: fix-and-recheck
      MISALIGNED: return-to-pm
      FAIL: major-rework
```


## Referência: references/squad/workflows/foundations-pipeline.yaml

```yaml
workflow:
  id: foundations-pipeline
  name: Design System Foundations Pipeline
  description: |
    Pipeline sequencial para adaptar shadcn/UI default para o design system do produto. Figma e a fonte de verdade. Cada fase tem QA gate bloqueante.
  version: 1.0.0
  type: sequential
  sequence:
    - step: step-1-ingest-tokens
      id: step-1-ingest-tokens
      phase: 1
      phase_name: Ingest Figma Tokens
      agent: ds-foundations-lead
      action: squads-design-tasks-f1-ingest-figma-tokens-md
      outputs:
        - normalized_tokens
      next: step-2-map-tokens
    - step: step-2-map-tokens
      id: step-2-map-tokens
      phase: 2
      phase_name: Map Tokens to shadcn CSS Variables
      agent: ds-foundations-lead
      action: squads-design-tasks-f1-map-tokens-to-shadcn-md
      outputs:
        - token_mapping
      next: step-3-apply-foundations
    - step: step-3-apply-foundations
      id: step-3-apply-foundations
      phase: 3
      phase_name: Apply Foundations to globals.css
      agent: ds-foundations-lead
      action: squads-design-tasks-f1-apply-foundations-md
      outputs:
        - globals_css
      next: step-4-qa-foundations
    - step: step-4-qa-foundations
      id: step-4-qa-foundations
      phase: 4
      phase_name: QA Gate — Foundations
      agent: ds-foundations-lead
      action: squads-design-tasks-f1-qa-foundations-md
      next: step-5-ingest-components
    - step: step-5-ingest-components
      id: step-5-ingest-components
      phase: 5
      phase_name: Ingest Base Component Specs from Figma
      agent: ds-foundations-lead
      action: squads-design-tasks-f2-ingest-base-components-md
      outputs:
        - component_specs
      next: step-6-adapt-components
    - step: step-6-adapt-components
      id: step-6-adapt-components
      phase: 6
      phase_name: Adapt shadcn Base Components
      agent: ds-foundations-lead
      action: squads-design-tasks-f2-adapt-shadcn-components-md
      outputs:
        - adapted_components
      next: step-7-qa-base-components
    - step: step-7-qa-base-components
      id: step-7-qa-base-components
      phase: 7
      phase_name: QA Gate — Base Components
      agent: ds-foundations-lead
      action: squads-design-tasks-f2-qa-base-components-md
      next: step-8-derive-components
    - step: step-8-derive-components
      id: step-8-derive-components
      phase: 8
      phase_name: Derive Remaining Components
      agent: ds-foundations-lead
      action: squads-design-tasks-f3-derive-components-md
      outputs:
        - all_components
      next: step-9-qa-final
    - step: step-9-qa-final
      id: step-9-qa-final
      phase: 9
      phase_name: QA Gate — Final (All Components)
      agent: ds-foundations-lead
      action: squads-design-tasks-f3-qa-derived-components-md
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
metadata:
  author: Foundations Lead
  created_date: "2026-02-21"
  last_modified: "2026-02-21"
  tags:
    - design-system
    - foundations
    - tokens
    - shadcn
    - figma
inputs:
  figma_tokens:
    type: string
    description: Raw token input from Figma (CSS, JSON, or manual text)
    required: true
  figma_components:
    type: string
    description: Component specs from Figma Dev Mode (CSS + screenshots)
    required: false
steps:
  - id: step_1_ingest_tokens
    name: Ingest Figma Tokens
    phase: 1
    type: agent
    agent: ds-foundations-lead
    task: squads/aiox-design/tasks/f1-ingest-figma-tokens.md
    inputs:
      raw_input: "{{figma_tokens}}"
    outputs:
      normalized_tokens: squads/aiox-design/data/tokens-normalized.json
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_2_map_tokens
    name: Map Tokens to shadcn CSS Variables
    phase: 1
    type: agent
    agent: ds-foundations-lead
    task: squads/aiox-design/tasks/f1-map-tokens-to-shadcn.md
    inputs:
      normalized_tokens: "{{step_1_ingest_tokens.normalized_tokens}}"
    outputs:
      token_mapping: squads/aiox-design/data/token-mapping-reference.md
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_3_apply_foundations
    name: Apply Foundations to globals.css
    phase: 1
    type: agent
    agent: ds-foundations-lead
    task: squads/aiox-design/tasks/f1-apply-foundations.md
    inputs:
      token_mapping: "{{step_2_map_tokens.token_mapping}}"
    outputs:
      globals_css: src/app/globals.css
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_4_qa_foundations
    name: QA Gate — Foundations
    phase: 1
    type: gate
    agent: ds-foundations-lead
    task: squads/aiox-design/tasks/f1-qa-foundations.md
    blocking: true
    checklist: squads/aiox-design/checklists/token-mapping-checklist.md
    verdicts:
      PASS: Proceed to Phase 2
      FAIL: Return to step_3 with fixes
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_5_ingest_components
    name: Ingest Base Component Specs from Figma
    phase: 2
    type: agent
    agent: ds-foundations-lead
    task: squads/aiox-design/tasks/f2-ingest-base-components.md
    inputs:
      figma_specs: "{{figma_components}}"
    outputs:
      component_specs: squads/aiox-design/data/component-specs.json
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_6_adapt_components
    name: Adapt shadcn Base Components
    phase: 2
    type: agent
    agent: ds-foundations-lead
    task: squads/aiox-design/tasks/f2-adapt-shadcn-components.md
    inputs:
      component_specs: "{{step_5_ingest_components.component_specs}}"
      token_mapping: "{{step_2_map_tokens.token_mapping}}"
    outputs:
      adapted_components: components/ui/
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_7_qa_base_components
    name: QA Gate — Base Components
    phase: 2
    type: gate
    agent: ds-foundations-lead
    task: squads/aiox-design/tasks/f2-qa-base-components.md
    blocking: true
    checklist: squads/aiox-design/checklists/component-adaptation-checklist.md
    verdicts:
      PASS: Proceed to Phase 3
      FAIL: Return to step_6 with fixes
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_8_derive_components
    name: Derive Remaining Components
    phase: 3
    type: agent
    agent: ds-foundations-lead
    task: squads/aiox-design/tasks/f3-derive-components.md
    inputs:
      adapted_components: "{{step_6_adapt_components.adapted_components}}"
      token_mapping: "{{step_2_map_tokens.token_mapping}}"
    outputs:
      all_components: components/ui/
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_9_qa_final
    name: QA Gate — Final (All Components)
    phase: 3
    type: gate
    agent: ds-foundations-lead
    task: squads/aiox-design/tasks/f3-qa-derived-components.md
    blocking: true
    checklist: squads/aiox-design/checklists/component-adaptation-checklist.md
    verdicts:
      PASS: Pipeline complete
      FAIL: Return to step_8 with fixes
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
outputs:
  pipeline_complete:
    type: boolean
    description: All 3 phases passed QA gates
    source: step_9_qa_final.success
  token_mapping:
    type: string
    description: Token mapping reference document
    source: step_2_map_tokens.token_mapping
  modified_files:
    type: array
    description: All files modified during the pipeline
    source: aggregated
global_error_handling:
  on_error: abort
  notification:
    enabled: true
    channels:
      - console
security:
  authorization_required: false
  audit_logging: true
```


## Referência: references/squad/workflows/greenfield-new.yaml

```yaml
workflow:
  id: design-system-greenfield-new
  name: Design System Greenfield New
  description: "Greenfield workflow: start fresh with token-based design system, build production components from scratch. Mandatory governance protocol: squads/aiox-design/protocols/ai-first-governance.md"
  version: 2.0.0
  type: sequential
  sequence:
    - step: step-1-setup
      id: step-1-setup
      phase: 1
      phase_name: Initialize Design System Structure
      agent: brad-frost
      action: setup
      outputs:
        - tokens_yaml
        - structure_created
        - state_file
      next: step-2-build-atoms
    - step: step-2-build-atoms
      id: step-2-build-atoms
      phase: 2
      phase_name: Build Atomic Components
      agent: brad-frost
      action: build
      outputs:
        - atoms
      next: step-3-compose-molecules
    - step: step-3-compose-molecules
      id: step-3-compose-molecules
      phase: 3
      phase_name: Compose Molecule Components
      agent: brad-frost
      action: compose
      outputs:
        - molecules
      next: step-4-compose-organisms
    - step: step-4-compose-organisms
      id: step-4-compose-organisms
      phase: 4
      phase_name: Compose Organism Components (Optional)
      agent: brad-frost
      action: compose
      outputs:
        - organisms
      next: step-5-document
    - step: step-5-document
      id: step-5-document
      phase: 5
      phase_name: Generate Pattern Library Documentation
      agent: brad-frost
      action: document
      outputs:
        - documentation
        - storybook
        - readme
      next: step-6-promote-to-workspace
    - step: step-6-promote-to-workspace
      id: step-6-promote-to-workspace
      phase: 6
      phase_name: Promote Outputs to Workspace Canonical Locations
      agent: brad-frost
      action: sync-registry
      outputs:
        - tokens_promoted
        - registry_updated
        - metadata_updated
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
metadata:
  author: Brad (Design System Architect)
  created_date: "2025-10-27"
  last_modified: "2026-02-16"
  tags:
    - design-system
    - greenfield
    - components
    - brad
inputs:
  project_name:
    type: string
    description: Project name for output organization
    required: true
    default: my-app
  tokens_source:
    type: string
    description: Path to existing tokens.yaml (optional - will generate starter tokens if not provided)
    required: false
  framework:
    type: string
    description: Component framework (react, vue, svelte)
    required: true
    default: react
    validation: "Must be: react, vue, or svelte"
steps:
  - id: step_1_setup
    name: Initialize Design System Structure
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*setup"
    inputs:
      project_name: "{{project_name}}"
      tokens_source: "{{tokens_source}}"
      framework: "{{framework}}"
    outputs:
      tokens_yaml: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/tokens/tokens.yaml
      structure_created: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/
      state_file: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/.state.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_2_build_atoms
    name: Build Atomic Components
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*build"
    inputs:
      tokens: "{{step_1_setup.tokens_yaml}}"
      patterns: button,input,label,icon,badge,avatar,spinner
    outputs:
      atoms: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/components/atoms/
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_3_compose_molecules
    name: Compose Molecule Components
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*compose"
    inputs:
      atoms: "{{step_2_build_atoms.atoms}}"
      patterns: form-field,card,alert,breadcrumb,pagination
    outputs:
      molecules: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/components/molecules/
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_4_compose_organisms
    name: Compose Organism Components (Optional)
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*compose"
    inputs:
      atoms: "{{step_2_build_atoms.atoms}}"
      molecules: "{{step_3_compose_molecules.molecules}}"
      patterns: form,table,modal,navigation
    outputs:
      organisms: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/components/organisms/
    error_handling:
      strategy: skip
  - id: step_5_document
    name: Generate Pattern Library Documentation
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*document"
    inputs:
      components: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/components/
      tokens: "{{step_1_setup.tokens_yaml}}"
    outputs:
      documentation: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/docs/
      storybook: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/.storybook/
      readme: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/README.md
    error_handling:
      strategy: skip
  - id: step_6_promote_to_workspace
    name: Promote Outputs to Workspace Canonical Locations
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*sync-registry"
    description: Move outputs from outputs/ to workspace canonical paths
    inputs:
      tokens_source: "{{step_1_setup.tokens_yaml}}"
      components_source: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/components/
    outputs:
      tokens_promoted: workspace/system/tokens/
      registry_updated: workspace/ui/registry.json
      metadata_updated: workspace/domains/design-system/metadata/components.json
    promotion_map:
      - from: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/tokens/tokens.json
        to: workspace/system/tokens/primitive.tokens.json
      - from: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/tokens/tokens.yaml
        to: squads/aiox-design/data/design-tokens-spec.yaml
      - from: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/components/
        to: workspace/ui/components/
    validation:
      - workspace/ui/registry.json updated with new components
      - workspace/domains/design-system/metadata/components.json reflects changes
      - squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/validate_components_metadata.cjs passes
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
outputs:
  design_system_complete:
    type: boolean
    description: Workflow completed successfully
    source: step_6_promote_to_workspace.success
  tokens_location:
    type: string
    description: Path to design tokens
    source: step_1_setup.tokens_yaml
  components_location:
    type: string
    description: Path to generated components
    source: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/components/
  documentation_location:
    type: string
    description: Path to pattern library documentation
    source: step_5_document.documentation
  storybook_location:
    type: string
    description: Path to Storybook configuration
    source: step_5_document.storybook
global_error_handling:
  on_error: abort
  notification:
    enabled: true
    channels:
      - console
security:
  authorization_required: false
  audit_logging: true
quality_gates:
  internal_quality_chain:
    required:
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/generate_components_metadata.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/validate_components_metadata.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/sync_design_manifest.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/validate_design_manifest_drift.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/validate_task_checklist_bindings.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/validate_mcp_skeleton.cjs
    optional:
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/test_mcp_tools.cjs
    blocking: true
    policy: internal-first
    exception:
      external_tool_allowed_with:
        - capability_gap_documented
        - rationale_recorded
```
