## Referência: references/squad/workflows/motion-quality.yaml

```yaml
workflow:
  id: design-system-motion-quality
  name: Design System Motion Quality (Kinetic Design System)
  description: >
    Full Kinetic Design System pipeline: audit existing motion, define token system,
    build primitives library, extract animations from reference URLs, replicate
    extracted motion as production CSS, validate visual regression, and run
    performance guard with token drift check.
    7 phases from audit to production-ready motion layer.
  version: 2.0.0
  type: sequential
  sequence:
    - step: step-1-motion-audit
      id: step-1-motion-audit
      phase: 1
      phase_name: Audit Motion Patterns
      agent: brad-frost
      action: motion-audit
      outputs:
        - motion_report
      next: step-2-motion-tokens

    - step: step-2-motion-tokens
      id: step-2-motion-tokens
      phase: 2
      phase_name: Define Motion Token System
      agent: brad-frost
      action: motion-tokens
      outputs:
        - motion_tokens_json
        - motion_tokens_css
        - motion_tokens_ts
      next: step-3-motion-primitives

    - step: step-3-motion-primitives
      id: step-3-motion-primitives
      phase: 3
      phase_name: Build Motion Primitives Library
      agent: brad-frost
      action: motion-primitives
      outputs:
        - motion_primitives_css
        - motion_primitives_tsx
        - motion_catalog
      next: step-4-motion-extraction

    - step: step-4-motion-extraction
      id: step-4-motion-extraction
      phase: 4
      phase_name: Extract Motion from Reference URLs
      agent: brad-frost
      action: motion-extraction
      optional: true
      outputs:
        - motion_map
        - extraction_report
      next: step-5-kinetic-replication

    - step: step-5-kinetic-replication
      id: step-5-kinetic-replication
      phase: 5
      phase_name: Replicate Extracted Motion as CSS
      agent: brad-frost
      action: kinetic-replication
      optional: true
      outputs:
        - replicated_motion_css
        - replication_report
      next: step-6-visual-regression-guard

    - step: step-6-visual-regression-guard
      id: step-6-visual-regression-guard
      phase: 6
      phase_name: Validate Visual Regression Baseline
      agent: brad-frost
      action: visual-regression
      tool: chromatic
      note: "Chromatic (@chromatic-com/storybook) already installed -- use as visual regression baseline (D13)"
      outputs:
        - visual_report
      next: step-7-performance-guard

    - step: step-7-performance-guard
      id: step-7-performance-guard
      phase: 7
      phase_name: Performance Guard & Token Drift Check
      agent: devops
      action: performance-guard
      optional: true
      on_error: warn
      outputs:
        - performance_report
        - drift_report

    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete

metadata:
  author: Brad (Design System Architect)
  created_date: "2026-02-17"
  last_modified: "2026-03-23"
  tags:
    - design-system
    - motion
    - kinetic-design
    - accessibility
    - quality
    - animation-primitives
    - scroll-driven
    - view-transitions
    - lighthouse-ci
    - performance-guard
    - token-drift

inputs:
  codebase_path:
    type: string
    description: Path to components/styles for motion analysis
    required: true
  project_name:
    type: string
    description: Project namespace for outputs
    required: true
    default: my-app
  reference_url:
    type: string
    description: URL to extract animations from (for Phase 4)
    required: false
  brand_personality:
    type: string
    description: "Motion personality: playful | professional | minimal | dramatic"
    required: false
    default: professional

steps:
  - id: step_1_motion_audit
    name: Audit Motion Patterns
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*motion-audit"
    inputs:
      path: "{{codebase_path}}"
    outputs:
      motion_report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/motion/motion-audit.md
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail

  - id: step_2_motion_tokens
    name: Define Motion Token System
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*motion-tokens"
    inputs:
      path: "{{codebase_path}}"
      personality: "{{brand_personality}}"
      motion_report: "{{step_1_motion_audit.motion_report}}"
    outputs:
      motion_tokens_json: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/motion/motion-tokens.json
      motion_tokens_css: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/motion/motion-tokens.css
      motion_tokens_ts: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/motion/motion-tokens.ts
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail

  - id: step_3_motion_primitives
    name: Build Motion Primitives Library
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*motion-primitives"
    inputs:
      path: "{{codebase_path}}"
      tokens_css: "{{step_2_motion_tokens.motion_tokens_css}}"
    outputs:
      motion_primitives_css: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/motion/motion-primitives.css
      motion_primitives_tsx: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/motion/motion-primitives.tsx
      motion_catalog: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/motion/motion-catalog.md
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail

  - id: step_4_motion_extraction
    name: Extract Motion from Reference URLs
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*motion-extraction"
    condition: "{{reference_url}} is set"
    inputs:
      url: "{{reference_url}}"
    outputs:
      motion_map: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/motion/motion-map.json
      extraction_report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/motion/extraction-report.md
    error_handling:
      strategy: skip

  - id: step_5_kinetic_replication
    name: Replicate Extracted Motion as CSS
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*kinetic-replication"
    condition: "{{step_4_motion_extraction.motion_map}} exists"
    inputs:
      motion_map: "{{step_4_motion_extraction.motion_map}}"
      path: "{{codebase_path}}"
    outputs:
      replicated_motion_css: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/motion/replicated-motion.css
      replication_report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/motion/replication-report.md
    error_handling:
      strategy: skip

  - id: step_6_visual_regression_guard
    name: Validate Visual Regression Baseline
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*visual-regression"
    tool: chromatic
    note: >
      Chromatic (@chromatic-com/storybook) is already installed in the project.
      Use Chromatic snapshots as the visual regression baseline for motion primitives (D13).
      Motion stories in Storybook are automatically captured by Chromatic on each build.
    inputs:
      path: "{{codebase_path}}"
      motion_report: "{{step_1_motion_audit.motion_report}}"
    outputs:
      visual_report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/motion/visual-regression.md
    error_handling:
      strategy: skip

  - id: step_7_performance_guard
    name: Performance Guard & Token Drift Check
    type: ci
    agent: devops
    optional: true
    description: >
      Lighthouse CI performance guard + token drift validation.
      Ensures motion layer does not degrade Core Web Vitals (D12, D13).
      Runs AFTER visual regression so that both visual and performance baselines are validated.
    performance_budgets:
      frame_budget: "<16ms per frame (60fps jank-free)"
      css_budget: "<5KB additional CSS from motion layer"
      core_web_vitals:
        CLS: "< 0.1"
        TBT: "< 200ms"
      animation_rules:
        - "No layout shifts during animations (transform + opacity only)"
        - "No animation on LCP element with delay > 0"
        - "prefers-reduced-motion fallback present for every @keyframes"
    sub_steps:
      - id: lighthouse_ci
        name: Lighthouse CI Performance Audit
        command: "lighthouse-ci"
        description: >
          Run Lighthouse CI against pages with motion applied.
          Verify CLS < 0.1, TBT < 200ms, no layout shifts during animations.
        assertions:
          - metric: cumulative-layout-shift
            operator: "<"
            value: 0.1
            level: error
          - metric: total-blocking-time
            operator: "<"
            value: 200
            level: error
          - metric: layout-shift-during-animation
            operator: "=="
            value: 0
            level: warn
            note: "Custom audit: detect layout-triggering properties in @keyframes (width, height, top, left, margin, padding)"
      - id: token_drift_check
        name: Token Drift Check (D12)
        description: >
          Verify that committed motion-tokens.css is in sync with the source schema.
          Pattern: Style Dictionary build → compare output with committed file → fail if divergent.
          Follows existing project pattern (tenant-tokens.generated.css).
        command: "style-dictionary build && diff"
        inputs:
          schema: "squads/aiox-design/data/motion-tokens-schema.yaml"
          committed_artifact: "outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/motion/motion-tokens.css"
        on_drift: warn
        note: >
          motion-tokens.css is committed as artifact (not generated at build time).
          CI validates committed == generated. If drift detected, warn but do not block.
      - id: reduced_motion_audit
        name: Reduced-Motion Completeness Audit
        description: >
          Grep-based check: every @keyframes must have a corresponding
          @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rule. Missing = warn.
        command: "grep-audit"
        on_missing_fallback: warn
    inputs:
      path: "{{codebase_path}}"
      motion_tokens_css: "{{step_2_motion_tokens.motion_tokens_css}}"
      visual_report: "{{step_6_visual_regression_guard.visual_report}}"
    outputs:
      performance_report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/motion/performance-guard.md
      drift_report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/motion/token-drift-report.md
    error_handling:
      strategy: skip
      on_error: warn
      note: >
        Performance guard is advisory. Failures produce warnings, never block the workflow.
        This ensures motion development is not gated on CI infrastructure availability.

outputs:
  motion_quality_complete:
    type: boolean
    source: step_1_motion_audit.success
  motion_report:
    type: string
    source: step_1_motion_audit.motion_report
  motion_tokens:
    type: string
    source: step_2_motion_tokens.motion_tokens_json
  motion_primitives:
    type: string
    source: step_3_motion_primitives.motion_primitives_css
  motion_map:
    type: string
    source: step_4_motion_extraction.motion_map
  replicated_motion_css:
    type: string
    source: step_5_kinetic_replication.replicated_motion_css
  performance_report:
    type: string
    source: step_7_performance_guard.performance_report
  drift_report:
    type: string
    source: step_7_performance_guard.drift_report
```


## Referência: references/squad/workflows/ops-audit.yaml

```yaml
workflow:
  id: designops-audit
  name: DesignOps Audit
  description: >
    Full DesignOps audit: scan DS source health, measure token drift across all consumer apps,
    measure component reuse rates, assess Three Lenses (Work/Grow/Thrive), and generate
    a remediation epic draft with prioritized stories.
    Combines Dave Malouf Three Lenses framework with automated cross-app scanning.
  version: 1.0.0
  type: sequential
  trigger: "*ops-audit {app_path}"

  sequence:
    - step: step-1-resolve-consumers
      id: step-1-resolve-consumers
      phase: 1
      phase_name: Resolve DS Source and Consumer Apps
      agent: design-chief
      action: resolve-consumers
      description: >
        Identify the DS source app and all consumer apps.
        Uses consumer-contracts.md if it exists, otherwise scans for bb-* imports
        and --bb-* token references across all apps/ directories.
      outputs:
        - ds_source_app
        - consumer_apps_list
      next: step-2-health-scan

    - step: step-2-health-scan
      id: step-2-health-scan
      phase: 2
      phase_name: DS Source Health Scan
      agent: brad-frost
      action: ds-health
      description: >
        Run ds-health-metrics on the DS source app.
        Measures: token coverage, component count, story coverage, test coverage,
        bundle size, code quality, consistency score.
      inputs:
        path: "{{app_path}}"
      outputs:
        - health_report
        - health_score
      next: step-3-token-drift-scan

    - step: step-3-token-drift-scan
      id: step-3-token-drift-scan
      phase: 3
      phase_name: Cross-App Token Drift Scan
      agent: ds-token-architect
      action: token-drift-scan
      description: >
        For each consumer app, measure:
        - Hardcoded hex/rgb/hsl count (in TSX/CSS, excluding token definition files)
        - Token reference count (--bb-* vars + bb-* Tailwind classes)
        - Token drift % = hardcoded / (hardcoded + token refs) * 100
        - Parallel token systems (e.g., --aiox-* competing with --bb-*)
        - Top 10 most common hardcoded values
      inputs:
        consumer_apps: "{{step-1-resolve-consumers.consumer_apps_list}}"
        ds_source: "{{step-1-resolve-consumers.ds_source_app}}"
      outputs:
        - token_drift_report
        - drift_per_app
        - parallel_token_systems
      next: step-4-reuse-scan

    - step: step-4-reuse-scan
      id: step-4-reuse-scan
      phase: 4
      phase_name: Cross-App Component Reuse Scan
      agent: brad-frost
      action: reuse-scan
      description: >
        For each consumer app, measure:
        - Which bb-* components are imported
        - Which are NOT used (orphaned in that app)
        - Reuse rate = used / available * 100
        - Duplicate components (custom Button that should be bb-button)
        - Import strategy (bb-* components vs shadcn/ui vs custom)
      inputs:
        consumer_apps: "{{step-1-resolve-consumers.consumer_apps_list}}"
        ds_source: "{{step-1-resolve-consumers.ds_source_app}}"
      outputs:
        - reuse_report
        - reuse_per_app
        - orphaned_components
        - duplicate_components
      next: step-5-three-lenses

    - step: step-5-three-lenses
      id: step-5-three-lenses
      phase: 5
      phase_name: Three Lenses Assessment (Dave Malouf)
      agent: dave-malouf
      action: three-lenses-assessment
      description: >
        Using data from phases 2-4, assess the DS across the Three Lenses:
        - Lens 1 (How We Work): atomic design, token pipeline, Storybook, handoff, CI gates, version control
        - Lens 2 (How We Grow): documentation, contribution guide, naming conventions, onboarding
        - Lens 3 (How We Thrive): adoption across apps, governance, community, multi-tenant
        Each lens scored 1-5. Overall maturity level: 1 (Ad Hoc) to 5 (Optimized).
      inputs:
        health_report: "{{step-2-health-scan.health_report}}"
        drift_report: "{{step-3-token-drift-scan.token_drift_report}}"
        reuse_report: "{{step-4-reuse-scan.reuse_report}}"
      outputs:
        - three_lenses_report
        - maturity_level
        - maturity_score
        - risk_register
      next: step-6-metrics-stack

    - step: step-6-metrics-stack
      id: step-6-metrics-stack
      phase: 6
      phase_name: Define Metrics Stack (Output/Outcome/Impact)
      agent: dave-malouf
      action: metrics-stack
      description: >
        Based on Three Lenses assessment, define the metrics stack:
        - Output metrics (what we produce): component count, story coverage, test coverage
        - Outcome metrics (adoption): reuse rate, token drift, handoff rejection, time-to-component
        - Impact metrics (business): feature velocity, visual consistency, onboarding time
        Include baselines from phases 2-4 and targets.
      inputs:
        three_lenses: "{{step-5-three-lenses.three_lenses_report}}"
        health_report: "{{step-2-health-scan.health_report}}"
        drift_report: "{{step-3-token-drift-scan.token_drift_report}}"
        reuse_report: "{{step-4-reuse-scan.reuse_report}}"
      outputs:
        - metrics_stack
        - health_dashboard
      next: step-7-generate-epic

    - step: step-7-generate-epic
      id: step-7-generate-epic
      phase: 7
      phase_name: Generate Remediation Epic Draft
      agent: design-chief
      action: generate-epic
      description: >
        Using all data from phases 1-6, generate an epic draft in docs/projects/aiox/epics/.
        The epic contains:
        - Stories for each P0/P1 finding (token drift elimination, CI gates, tests)
        - Wave execution plan (parallel where possible)
        - Success criteria with baselines and targets from metrics stack
        - Dependency map between stories
        Format follows existing epic pattern (see epic-workspace-sophistication as reference).
      inputs:
        three_lenses: "{{step-5-three-lenses.three_lenses_report}}"
        metrics_stack: "{{step-6-metrics-stack.metrics_stack}}"
        risk_register: "{{step-5-three-lenses.risk_register}}"
        drift_report: "{{step-3-token-drift-scan.token_drift_report}}"
        reuse_report: "{{step-4-reuse-scan.reuse_report}}"
        health_report: "{{step-2-health-scan.health_report}}"
      outputs:
        - epic_draft
        - epic_path
      next: step-8-persist-report

    - step: step-8-persist-report
      id: step-8-persist-report
      phase: 8
      phase_name: Persist Audit Report
      agent: design-chief
      action: persist
      description: >
        Save all outputs to outputs/design/ops-audit/{date}/.
        This ensures progressive output saving (never accumulate only in context).
      outputs:
        - audit_report_path
      next: complete

    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete

metadata:
  author: Dave Malouf (DesignOps) + Design Chief (Orchestration)
  created_date: "2026-03-25"
  last_modified: "2026-03-25"
  tags:
    - designops
    - audit
    - token-drift
    - component-reuse
    - three-lenses
    - metrics-stack
    - epic-generation

inputs:
  app_path:
    type: string
    description: Path to the DS source app (e.g., apps/aiox-design-system)
    required: true
    validation: Must be valid directory path containing a design system
  project_name:
    type: string
    description: Project name for output organization
    required: false
    default: aiox-ds

outputs:
  audit_complete:
    type: boolean
    description: Full ops audit completed
    source: step-8-persist-report.success
  health_score:
    type: number
    description: DS health score (0-100)
    source: step-2-health-scan.health_score
  maturity_level:
    type: string
    description: "DesignOps maturity: Ad Hoc | Emerging | Defined | Managed | Optimized"
    source: step-5-three-lenses.maturity_level
  token_drift_avg:
    type: number
    description: Average token drift across all consumers (%)
    source: step-3-token-drift-scan.drift_per_app
  epic_path:
    type: string
    description: Path to generated remediation epic
    source: step-7-generate-epic.epic_path
  report_path:
    type: string
    description: Path to persisted audit report
    source: step-8-persist-report.audit_report_path

global_error_handling:
  on_error: continue_with_partial
  notification:
    enabled: true
    channels:
      - console

security:
  authorization_required: false
  audit_logging: true
```


## Referência: references/squad/workflows/page-composition.yaml

```yaml
workflow:
  id: page-composition
  name: Page Composition Workflow
  description: |
    Compose complete pages using a deterministic 9-phase chain: page type detection, template selection, optional copy bridge, layout/typography/spacing application, component selection, code generation, and quality validation.
  version: 1.0.0
  type: sequential
  sequence:
    - step: step-1-identify-and-constrain
      id: step-1-identify-and-constrain
      phase: 1
      phase_name: Validate brief, identify page type, and apply constraints
      agent: page-composer
      action: compose-page
      outputs:
        - page_type_decision
        - resolved_constraints
        - brief_validation
      next: step-2-select-template-base
    - step: step-2-select-template-base
      id: step-2-select-template-base
      phase: 2
      phase_name: Select template base
      agent: page-composer
      action: compose-page
      outputs:
        - template_selection
      next: step-3-apply-copy-layout-bridge
    - step: step-3-apply-copy-layout-bridge
      id: step-3-apply-copy-layout-bridge
      phase: 3
      phase_name: Apply copy-to-layout bridge (conditional)
      agent: page-composer
      action: copy-layout
      outputs:
        - bridge_map
      next: step-4-apply-layout-framework
    - step: step-4-apply-layout-framework
      id: step-4-apply-layout-framework
      phase: 4
      phase_name: Apply layout framework
      agent: page-composer
      action: compose-page
      outputs:
        - layout_spec
      next: step-5-apply-typography-hierarchy
    - step: step-5-apply-typography-hierarchy
      id: step-5-apply-typography-hierarchy
      phase: 5
      phase_name: Apply typography hierarchy
      agent: page-composer
      action: typography-map
      outputs:
        - typography_map
      next: step-6-apply-spacing-rhythm
    - step: step-6-apply-spacing-rhythm
      id: step-6-apply-spacing-rhythm
      phase: 6
      phase_name: Apply spacing rhythm
      agent: page-composer
      action: spacing-check
      outputs:
        - spacing_spec
      next: step-7-select-shadcn-components
    - step: step-7-select-shadcn-components
      id: step-7-select-shadcn-components
      phase: 7
      phase_name: Select shadcn components
      agent: page-composer
      action: compose-page
      outputs:
        - component_plan
      next: step-8-generate-react-tailwind-shadcn-code
    - step: step-8-generate-react-tailwind-shadcn-code
      id: step-8-generate-react-tailwind-shadcn-code
      phase: 8
      phase_name: Generate React + Tailwind + shadcn code with SEO and states
      agent: page-composer
      action: compose-page
      outputs:
        - page_code
        - implementation_notes
      next: step-9-validate-quality-gate
    - step: step-9-validate-quality-gate
      id: step-9-validate-quality-gate
      phase: 9
      phase_name: Validate page composition quality gate (10 sections)
      agent: page-composer
      action: squads-design-tasks-execute-checklist-md
      outputs:
        - validation_report
        - qa_verdict
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
metadata:
  author: Page Composer
  created_date: "2026-03-06"
  last_modified: "2026-03-06"
  tags:
    - design-system
    - page-composition
    - page-composer
    - shadcn
    - workflow
inputs:
  project_name:
    type: string
    description: Project namespace used in output paths.
    required: true
    default: page-composition
  page_brief:
    type: string
    description: Business intent and page objective.
    required: true
  product_surface:
    type: string
    description: "3-Input Framework (v0): specific components, data fields, and user actions."
    required: false
  context_of_use:
    type: string
    description: "3-Input Framework (v0): who uses it, when, to make what decision."
    required: false
  constraints:
    type: string
    description: "3-Input Framework (v0): device, visual tone (buzzwords), palette, layout restrictions."
    required: false
  page_type:
    type: string
    description: Optional explicit page type. If empty, detect from page_brief.
    required: false
  template_choice:
    type: string
    description: Template variant approved by user in phase 2.
    required: false
  copy_briefing:
    type: string
    description: Optional copy briefing (AIDA/PAS/StoryBrand).
    required: false
  target_route:
    type: string
    description: Route or file target for generated page.
    required: false
    default: app/page.tsx
steps:
  - id: step_1_identify_and_constrain
    name: Validate brief, identify page type, and apply constraints
    phase: 1
    type: agent
    agent: page-composer
    command: "*compose-page"
    description: |
      FIRST: Validates brief against brief-validation-checklist.md (8-point check). If score < 5/8, BLOCKS composition and asks user for missing inputs. THEN: Identifies page type AND processes constraints upfront (constraint-first pattern). If 3-Input brief provided (product_surface + context_of_use + constraints), extract page type, design tone buzzwords, and device/layout constraints. If brief is vague, ask user for the 3 inputs before proceeding. Design tone buzzwords are resolved to concrete decisions using KB2 Section 0 (Design Tone Vocabulary) and carried through all subsequent phases. Optionally references prompt-templates-library.md to suggest a matching template.
    knowledge_base:
      - squads/aiox-design/data/page-type-patterns.md
      - squads/aiox-design/data/prompt-templates-library.md
    checklists:
      - squads/aiox-design/checklists/brief-validation-checklist.md
    inputs:
      page_brief: "{{page_brief}}"
      product_surface: "{{product_surface}}"
      context_of_use: "{{context_of_use}}"
      constraints: "{{constraints}}"
      explicit_type: "{{page_type}}"
    outputs:
      page_type_decision: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/page-composition/step-1-page-type.yaml
      resolved_constraints: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/page-composition/step-1-constraints.yaml
      brief_validation: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/page-composition/step-1-brief-validation.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_2_select_template_base
    name: Select template base
    phase: 2
    type: agent
    agent: page-composer
    command: "*compose-page"
    elicitation:
      required: true
      prompt: Confirm the template to use for the selected page type.
      options_source: squads/aiox-design/data/page-type-patterns.md
    knowledge_base:
      - squads/aiox-design/data/page-type-patterns.md
    inputs:
      selected_page_type: "{{step_1_identify_and_constrain.page_type_decision}}"
      template_choice: "{{template_choice}}"
    outputs:
      template_selection: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/page-composition/step-2-template-selection.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_3_apply_copy_layout_bridge
    name: Apply copy-to-layout bridge (conditional)
    phase: 3
    type: agent
    agent: page-composer
    command: "*copy-layout"
    conditional:
      when: "{{copy_briefing}}"
      behavior:
        on_truthy: execute
        on_falsy: skip
      skip_output:
        bridge_map: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/page-composition/step-3-copy-bridge-skipped.yaml
      skip_reason: No copy briefing provided; continue with structural composition only.
    knowledge_base:
      - squads/aiox-design/data/copy-to-layout-bridge.md
    inputs:
      copy_briefing: "{{copy_briefing}}"
      page_type: "{{step_1_identify_and_constrain.page_type_decision}}"
      template: "{{step_2_select_template_base.template_selection}}"
    outputs:
      bridge_map: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/page-composition/step-3-copy-bridge.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: skip
  - id: step_4_apply_layout_framework
    name: Apply layout framework
    phase: 4
    type: agent
    agent: page-composer
    command: "*compose-page"
    knowledge_base:
      - squads/aiox-design/data/page-layout-framework.md
    inputs:
      template_selection: "{{step_2_select_template_base.template_selection}}"
      copy_mapping: "{{step_3_apply_copy_layout_bridge.bridge_map}}"
      resolved_constraints: "{{step_1_identify_and_constrain.resolved_constraints}}"
    outputs:
      layout_spec: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/page-composition/step-4-layout-spec.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_5_apply_typography_hierarchy
    name: Apply typography hierarchy
    phase: 5
    type: agent
    agent: page-composer
    command: "*typography-map"
    knowledge_base:
      - squads/aiox-design/data/typography-hierarchy-rules.md
    inputs:
      layout_spec: "{{step_4_apply_layout_framework.layout_spec}}"
      page_type: "{{step_1_identify_and_constrain.page_type_decision}}"
    outputs:
      typography_map: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/page-composition/step-5-typography-map.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_6_apply_spacing_rhythm
    name: Apply spacing rhythm
    phase: 6
    type: agent
    agent: page-composer
    command: "*spacing-check"
    knowledge_base:
      - squads/aiox-design/data/spacing-rhythm-system.md
    inputs:
      layout_spec: "{{step_4_apply_layout_framework.layout_spec}}"
      typography_map: "{{step_5_apply_typography_hierarchy.typography_map}}"
    outputs:
      spacing_spec: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/page-composition/step-6-spacing-spec.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_7_select_shadcn_components
    name: Select shadcn components
    phase: 7
    type: agent
    agent: page-composer
    command: "*compose-page"
    data_sources:
      - squads/aiox-design/data/component-index.json
      - shadcn blocks skill (DS-PC-6)
    inputs:
      page_type: "{{step_1_identify_and_constrain.page_type_decision}}"
      layout_spec: "{{step_4_apply_layout_framework.layout_spec}}"
      bridge_map: "{{step_3_apply_copy_layout_bridge.bridge_map}}"
      spacing_spec: "{{step_6_apply_spacing_rhythm.spacing_spec}}"
    outputs:
      component_plan: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/page-composition/step-7-component-plan.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_8_generate_react_tailwind_shadcn_code
    name: Generate React + Tailwind + shadcn code with SEO and states
    phase: 8
    type: agent
    agent: page-composer
    command: "*compose-page"
    description: |
      Assembles all phase outputs into production-ready page code. INCLUDES: SEO metadata generation (title, description, JSON-LD, canonical) per seo-rules.md, and component states (loading/empty/error) for all data-dependent sections per compose-component-states.md.
    knowledge_base:
      - squads/aiox-design/data/seo-rules.md
      - squads/aiox-design/data/anti-ai-look-patterns.md
      - squads/aiox-design/data/page-layout-framework.md#8-mobile-first-mandatory-patterns
    inputs:
      layout_spec: "{{step_4_apply_layout_framework.layout_spec}}"
      typography_map: "{{step_5_apply_typography_hierarchy.typography_map}}"
      spacing_spec: "{{step_6_apply_spacing_rhythm.spacing_spec}}"
      component_plan: "{{step_7_select_shadcn_components.component_plan}}"
      resolved_constraints: "{{step_1_identify_and_constrain.resolved_constraints}}"
      target_route: "{{target_route}}"
    outputs:
      page_code: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/page-composition/step-8-page.tsx
      implementation_notes: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/page-composition/step-8-implementation-notes.md
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_9_validate_quality_gate
    name: Validate page composition quality gate (10 sections)
    phase: 9
    type: gate
    agent: page-composer
    task: squads/aiox-design/tasks/execute-checklist.md
    checklist: squads/aiox-design/checklists/page-composition-checklist.md
    description: |
      Validates against the full 10-section checklist: 1. Layout Grid, 2. Typography, 3. Spacing, 4. Responsive, 5. CTA Contrast, 6. Copy-to-Layout, 7. Accessibility, 8. Anti-AI Look, 9. SEO Metadata, 10. Component States. Also validates brief was validated (Prerequisites section).
    knowledge_base:
      - squads/aiox-design/checklists/page-composition-checklist.md
      - squads/aiox-design/checklists/seo-meta-checklist.md
      - squads/aiox-design/data/anti-ai-look-patterns.md
    inputs:
      page_code: "{{step_8_generate_react_tailwind_shadcn_code.page_code}}"
      layout_spec: "{{step_4_apply_layout_framework.layout_spec}}"
      typography_map: "{{step_5_apply_typography_hierarchy.typography_map}}"
      spacing_spec: "{{step_6_apply_spacing_rhythm.spacing_spec}}"
      component_plan: "{{step_7_select_shadcn_components.component_plan}}"
      brief_validation: "{{step_1_identify_and_constrain.brief_validation}}"
    outputs:
      validation_report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/page-composition/step-9-validation-report.md
      qa_verdict: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/page-composition/step-9-verdict.yaml
    verdicts:
      PASS: Workflow complete
      CONCERNS: Workflow complete with non-blocking recommendations
      FAIL: Return to step_4_apply_layout_framework with fixes
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
outputs:
  composition_complete:
    type: boolean
    description: True when step 9 passes gate criteria.
    source: step_9_validate_quality_gate.success
  selected_page_type:
    type: string
    description: Final selected page type.
    source: step_1_identify_and_constrain.page_type_decision
  selected_template:
    type: string
    description: Template base approved in elicitation phase.
    source: step_2_select_template_base.template_selection
  generated_page_code:
    type: string
    description: Generated React page implementation.
    source: step_8_generate_react_tailwind_shadcn_code.page_code
  validation_report:
    type: string
    description: Quality gate output report.
    source: step_9_validate_quality_gate.validation_report
global_error_handling:
  on_error: abort
  notification:
    enabled: true
    channels:
      - console
security:
  authorization_required: false
  audit_logging: true
quality_gates:
  internal_quality_chain:
    required:
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/generate_components_metadata.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/validate_components_metadata.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/sync_design_manifest.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/validate_design_manifest_drift.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/validate_task_checklist_bindings.cjs
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/validate_mcp_skeleton.cjs
    optional:
      - node squads/aiox-design/scripts/design-system/test_mcp_tools.cjs
    blocking: true
    policy: internal-first
```


## Referência: references/squad/workflows/self-healing-workflow.yaml

```yaml
name: self-healing-design-system
id: self-healing-workflow
version: 1.0.0
description: |
  Workflow de auto-correção para design system.
  Usa ferramentas existentes (Vercel, CodeRabbit, GitHub Actions) para detectar e corrigir problemas automaticamente.
type: legacy
triggers:
  - on_push:
      paths:
        - workspace/ui/**
        - workspace/system/**
        - workspace/domains/design-system/**
  - on_pr:
      paths:
        - "**/*.tsx"
        - "**/*.css"
  - scheduled:
      cron: 0 6 * * 1
detection:
  lint:
    tool: eslint
    config: .eslintrc.js
    auto_fix: true
    severity_threshold: warning
  typecheck:
    tool: typescript
    config: tsconfig.json
    strict: true
  accessibility:
    tool: axe-core
    rules:
      - wcag2aa
      - best-practice
    severity_threshold: serious
  token_drift:
    tool: custom
    script: scripts/detect-token-drift.cjs
    checks:
      - hardcoded_colors: true
      - hardcoded_spacing: true
      - missing_css_vars: true
  registry_sync:
    tool: custom
    script: scripts/validate-registry-sync.cjs
    checks:
      - component_count_match: true
      - metadata_completeness: true
auto_fix:
  automatic:
    - type: lint
      action: eslint --fix
      commit_message: "fix(ds): auto-fix lint issues"
    - type: formatting
      action: prettier --write
      commit_message: "style(ds): auto-format code"
    - type: imports
      action: "eslint --fix --rule 'import/order: error'"
      commit_message: "fix(ds): organize imports"
  requires_approval:
    - type: token_replacement
      description: Substituir hardcoded values por tokens
      action: scripts/replace-hardcoded-tokens.cjs
      approval_channel: "#design-system"
    - type: a11y_fix
      description: Adicionar atributos de acessibilidade
      action: scripts/add-a11y-attributes.cjs
      approval_channel: "#design-system"
    - type: component_migration
      description: Migrar componente para novo padrão
      action: scripts/migrate-component.cjs
      approval_channel: "#design-system"
integrations:
  vercel:
    enabled: true
    features:
      - preview_deployments: true
      - build_error_detection: true
      - performance_monitoring: true
    auto_actions:
      - on_build_fail: notify_slack
      - on_perf_regression: create_issue
  coderabbit:
    enabled: true
    features:
      - pr_review: true
      - security_scan: true
      - pattern_detection: true
    config:
      focus:
        - design_system_patterns
        - accessibility
        - token_usage
  github_actions:
    enabled: true
    workflows:
      - design-ci.yml
      - copy-lint.yml
    auto_actions:
      - on_check_fail: add_comment
      - on_fix_available: create_suggestion
  sentry:
    enabled: true
    features:
      - error_tracking: true
      - performance_monitoring: true
    alerts:
      - on_spike: notify_slack
      - on_new_error: create_issue
notifications:
  channels:
    slack:
      webhook: ${SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL}
      channel: "#design-system"
    github:
      issues: true
      prs: true
      comments: true
  templates:
    auto_fix_applied:
      title: 🔧 Auto-fix applied
      body: |
        **Type:** {fix_type}
        **Files:** {files_changed}
        **Commit:** {commit_sha}
    fix_requires_approval:
      title: ⚠️ Fix requires approval
      body: |
        **Type:** {fix_type}
        **Description:** {description}
        **Impact:** {files_affected} files
        **Action:** Review and approve in PR #{pr_number}
    detection_report:
      title: 📊 Weekly Design System Health
      body: |
        **Period:** {start_date} - {end_date}

        **Issues Detected:** {total_issues}
        **Auto-fixed:** {auto_fixed} ({auto_fix_rate}%)
        **Pending Review:** {pending_review}

        **Top Issues:**
        {top_issues_list}
metrics:
  track:
    - auto_fix_rate
    - detection_accuracy
    - mean_time_to_fix
    - issues_by_type
    - issues_by_component
  targets:
    auto_fix_rate: 80%
    mean_time_to_fix: < 24h
    detection_accuracy: 95%
rollback:
  enabled: true
  triggers:
    - build_failure_after_fix
    - test_failure_after_fix
    - manual_request
  actions:
    - revert_commit
    - notify_team
    - create_incident
quality_gates:
  pre_merge:
    - lint_pass: required
    - typecheck_pass: required
    - a11y_pass: required
    - token_drift_check: required
    - registry_sync: required
  post_deploy:
    - lighthouse_score: ">= 90"
    - core_web_vitals: pass
    - error_rate: < 0.1%
workflow:
  id: self-healing-workflow
  name: self-healing-design-system
  version: 1.0.0
  description: |
    Workflow de auto-correção para design system.
    Usa ferramentas existentes (Vercel, CodeRabbit, GitHub Actions) para detectar e corrigir problemas automaticamente.
  type: legacy
  sequence:
    - step: sequence
      id: sequence
      phase: 1
      phase_name: sequence
      agent: aiox-master
      action: execute_process-section-sequence
      next: detection
    - step: detection
      id: detection
      phase: 2
      phase_name: detection
      agent: aiox-master
      action: execute_process-section-detection
      next: auto-fix
    - step: auto-fix
      id: auto-fix
      phase: 3
      phase_name: auto_fix
      agent: aiox-master
      action: execute_process-section-auto-fix
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
```


## Referência: references/squad/workflows/storybook-brownfield-migration.yaml

```yaml
workflow:
  id: wf-storybook-brownfield-migration
  name: Storybook Brownfield Migration Pipeline
  version: "1.0"
  orchestrator: "@storybook-expert"
  duration: 1-3 sessions
  description: |
    End-to-end pipeline for migrating brownfield codebases into Storybook.
    Takes ANY existing React/Next.js project and produces:
    - Complete component inventory with atomic classification
    - Dependency graph showing component relationships
    - Phased migration plan (atoms → molecules → organisms → templates → pages)
    - Story files for EVERY component
    - Mock decorators for context-dependent components
    - Adaptation report documenting all changes

    Supports same-project (add stories) and cross-project (copy + add stories) modes.
  best_for:
    - Existing project with 20-200+ undocumented components
    - Migrating components from one project to another
    - Design system adoption in legacy codebases
    - Component library documentation from scratch
    - Atomization of monolithic UI code
  decision_matrix_fit:
    awareness: Migration
    sophistication: Advanced
    primary_output: Complete Storybook with brownfield component stories
  migration_modes:
    same_project:
      description: Add stories co-located with existing components
      when: Project already has Storybook or components stay in place
      output: "*.stories.tsx next to each component"
    cross_project:
      description: Copy components to target project, adapt imports, add stories
      when: Building a separate design system package
      output: Components + stories in target project
  type: legacy
  sequence:
    - step: phase-1
      id: phase-1
      phase: 1
      phase_name: Scan & Classify Components
      agent: storybook-expert
      action: execute_walk-the-source-codebase-and-produce-a-complete-component-invent
      next: phase-2
    - step: phase-2
      id: phase-2
      phase: 2
      phase_name: Prepare Storybook Environment
      agent: storybook-expert
      action: execute_ensure-target-project-has-storybook-installed-and-configured
      next: phase-3
    - step: phase-3
      id: phase-3
      phase: 3
      phase_name: Rename Existing Stories to Atomic Design
      agent: storybook-expert
      action: execute_if-the-project-already-has-storybook-stories-with-flat-or-legacy
      next: phase-4
    - step: phase-4
      id: phase-4
      phase: 4
      phase_name: Migrate Atoms & Primitives
      agent: storybook-expert
      action: execute_migrate-all-atom-level-components-first
      next: phase-5
    - step: phase-5
      id: phase-5
      phase: 5
      phase_name: Migrate Molecules
      agent: storybook-expert
      action: execute_migrate-molecule-level-components
      next: phase-6
    - step: phase-6
      id: phase-6
      phase: 6
      phase_name: Migrate Organisms & Features
      agent: storybook-expert
      action: execute_migrate-organism-level-components
      next: phase-7
    - step: phase-7
      id: phase-7
      phase: 7
      phase_name: Extract Shared Molecules
      agent: brad-frost
      action: execute_after-organisms-are-migrated-analyze-them-for-inline-patterns-th
      next: phase-8
    - step: phase-8
      id: phase-8
      phase: 8
      phase_name: Migrate Templates & Pages
      agent: storybook-expert
      action: execute_migrate-template-and-page-level-components
      next: phase-9
    - step: phase-9
      id: phase-9
      phase: 9
      phase_name: Verify Complete Migration
      agent: storybook-expert
      action: execute_final-verification-of-the-complete-brownfield-migration
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
  handoff_prompts:
    storybook-expert_to_brad-frost: Handoff context from storybook-expert to brad-frost. Preserve outputs, risks, and open decisions.
    brad-frost_to_storybook-expert: Handoff context from brad-frost to storybook-expert. Preserve outputs, risks, and open decisions.
phases:
  - id: PHASE-1
    name: Scan & Classify Components
    tier: 0
    description: |
      Walk the source codebase and produce a complete component inventory.
      Classify each component by atomic level (atom/molecule/organism/template/page),
      map dependencies between components, and generate a phased migration plan
      ordered by dependency tree.
    tasks:
      - task_file: sb-brownfield-scan.md
        agent: "@storybook-expert"
        required: true
        description: Inventory all components, classify, build dependency graph
        output: component-inventory.json, migration-plan.md, dependency-graph.json
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - All component files scanned and classified
        - Dependency graph has no unresolved references
        - Migration plan has at least 2 phases
        - Atomic distribution covers atom through organism minimum
      human_review: true
      message: |
        Scan complete. Review the migration plan before proceeding.
        - Total components: {total_components}
        - Atoms: {atoms} | Molecules: {molecules} | Organisms: {organisms}
        - Already have stories: {with_stories}
        - Need stories: {migration_gap}
        Approve to proceed with migration, or adjust plan.
  - id: PHASE-2
    name: Prepare Storybook Environment
    tier: 0
    description: |
      Ensure target project has Storybook installed and configured.
      If not present, run sb-install and sb-configure. If present,
      verify stories glob covers brownfield component locations.
    tasks:
      - task_file: sb-install.md
        agent: "@storybook-expert"
        required: false
        description: Install Storybook if not present (skip if exists)
        output: installed_packages
        notes: |
          CONDITIONAL: Only execute if target project has no Storybook.
          Check for .storybook/ directory and storybook in devDependencies.
      - task_file: sb-configure.md
        agent: "@storybook-expert"
        required: false
        description: Configure Storybook if not configured (skip if exists)
        output: .storybook/main.ts, .storybook/preview.ts
        notes: |
          CONDITIONAL: Only execute if .storybook/main.ts doesn't exist.
          If exists, verify stories glob covers component paths.
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - Storybook is installed and configured
        - Stories glob covers all component locations from scan
        - Storybook dev server starts without errors
      human_review: false
      message: Storybook environment ready. Starting migration.
  - id: PHASE-3
    name: Rename Existing Stories to Atomic Design
    tier: 0
    description: |
      If the project already has Storybook stories with flat or legacy titles
      (e.g., "UI/Button", "Base Components/Card"), rename them to Atomic Design
      hierarchy before creating new stories. This ensures consistent naming
      across old and new stories.

      Title convention:
      - Atoms/{Subcategory}/{Name}    (Forms, Data Display, Layout, Feedback)
      - Molecules/{Subcategory}/{Name} (Overlays, Navigation, Forms, Data Display, Content)
      - Organisms/{Domain}/{Name}      (grouped by domain directory)
      - Templates/{Name}               (flat)
      - Pages/{Name}                   (flat)
    tasks:
      - task_file: sb-atomic-rename.md
        agent: "@storybook-expert"
        required: false
        description: Rename existing story titles to Atomic Design hierarchy
        output: renamed_stories, rename_report
        notes: |
          CONDITIONAL: Only execute if project has existing stories with non-Atomic titles.
          If all stories already use Atoms/Molecules/Organisms prefix, skip this phase.
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - Zero stories with legacy title prefix (UI/, Base Components/, Core Components/)
        - All stories use {AtomicLevel}/{Subcategory}/{Name} pattern
        - TypeScript typecheck passes
      human_review: false
      message: Story titles migrated to Atomic Design hierarchy.
  - id: PHASE-4
    name: Migrate Atoms & Primitives
    tier: 1
    description: |
      Migrate all atom-level components first. These have zero internal
      dependencies and form the foundation for all other components.
      Typically: buttons, badges, avatars, inputs, labels, separators, icons.
    tasks:
      - task_file: sb-brownfield-migrate.md
        agent: "@storybook-expert"
        required: true
        description: Generate stories for all atom components
        output: story_files (atoms)
        notes: |
          Execute with: phase_filter="1" (atoms phase from migration plan)
          These components should need NO mocks or decorators.
          Strategy: args-driven stories with Default + Variants + Gallery.
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - All atom components have stories
        - npm run typecheck passes
        - All atoms render in Storybook without errors
      human_review: false
      message: Atoms migrated. Foundation complete.
  - id: PHASE-5
    name: Migrate Molecules
    tier: 1
    description: |
      Migrate molecule-level components. These compose 2-3 atoms into
      reusable patterns. May need render functions to show composition.
      Typically: InputWithLabel, CardHeader, NavItem, SearchBar.
    tasks:
      - task_file: sb-brownfield-migrate.md
        agent: "@storybook-expert"
        required: true
        description: Generate stories for all molecule components
        output: story_files (molecules)
        notes: |
          Execute with: phase_filter matching molecule phases from migration plan.
          Strategy: render function stories showing composition.
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - All molecule components have stories
        - npm run typecheck passes
        - Molecules render correctly (atoms are available)
      human_review: false
      message: Molecules migrated.
  - id: PHASE-6
    name: Migrate Organisms & Features
    tier: 2
    description: |
      Migrate organism-level components. These are section-level components
      with business logic, context dependencies, and multiple internal deps.
      This phase typically requires the most adaptations (mock providers,
      stub data, decorator wrappers).

      Includes: AgentCard, KanbanColumn, ChatContainer, Sidebar, etc.
    tasks:
      - task_file: sb-brownfield-migrate.md
        agent: "@storybook-expert"
        required: true
        description: Generate stories for organisms with necessary mocks
        output: story_files (organisms), mock_files
        notes: |
          Execute with: phase_filter matching organism phases.
          Strategy: render function + decorators for context.
          Create mock providers in .storybook/mocks/ as needed.
          Document every adaptation in the report.
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - All organism components have stories
        - Mock decorators created for context-dependent components
        - npm run typecheck passes
        - All adaptations documented in report
      human_review: true
      message: |
        Organisms migrated. This phase had the most adaptations.
        Review mock files and adaptations before proceeding to molecule extraction.
  - id: PHASE-7
    name: Extract Shared Molecules
    tier: 2
    description: |
      After organisms are migrated, analyze them for inline patterns that
      should be extracted as reusable molecules. When 2+ organisms share
      the same composed UI pattern (ProgressRing, UserChip, StatCard, etc.),
      extract it into a standalone molecule with its own story.

      This enforces Atomic Design composition rules:
      - Organisms compose molecules + atoms
      - Organisms should NOT inline what could be a molecule
      - Shared patterns become molecules, reducing duplication
    tasks:
      - task_file: sb-extract-molecules.md
        agent: "@brad-frost"
        required: false
        description: Extract shared patterns from organisms into molecules
        output: new_molecules, updated_organisms, extraction_report
        notes: |
          CONDITIONAL: Only execute if scan identified shared patterns across organisms.
          If no shared patterns found, skip this phase.
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - All identified shared patterns extracted
        - New molecules have stories with Molecules/ prefix
        - Updated organisms still render correctly
        - TypeScript typecheck passes
      human_review: true
      message: |
        Molecule extraction complete. Review new molecules and verify
        organisms still render identically.
  - id: PHASE-8
    name: Migrate Templates & Pages
    tier: 2
    description: |
      Migrate template and page-level components. These are full layouts
      and pages that compose organisms. Need layout: "fullscreen" parameter
      and comprehensive mock data.
    tasks:
      - task_file: sb-brownfield-migrate.md
        agent: "@storybook-expert"
        required: true
        description: Generate stories for templates and pages
        output: story_files (templates, pages)
        notes: |
          Execute with: phase_filter matching template/page phases.
          Use parameters: { layout: "fullscreen" } for layout components.
          May need mock routing, mock API responses, mock global state.
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - All template and page components have stories
        - Layout stories use fullscreen layout
        - npm run typecheck passes
      human_review: false
      message: Templates and pages migrated. Running final verification.
  - id: PHASE-9
    name: Verify Complete Migration
    tier: 2
    description: |
      Final verification of the complete brownfield migration.
      Runs typecheck, lint, build, story coverage check, and
      generates the final adaptation report.
    tasks:
      - task_file: sb-verify.md
        agent: "@storybook-expert"
        required: true
        description: Run all verification checks
        output: verification_report
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - "TypeScript: zero errors"
        - "Lint: zero errors"
        - "Build: succeeds"
        - "Coverage: 100% of planned components"
        - Adaptation report complete
      human_review: true
      message: Migration complete. Review final report.
error_handling:
  on_phase_failure:
    - log_error: true
    - notify_stakeholders: false
    - create_remediation_task: false
    - halt_workflow: true
  on_checkpoint_failure:
    - log_failure_reason: true
    - return_to_previous_phase: false
    - max_retries: 3
  phase_specific:
    PHASE-6_organisms:
      description: Organisms phase most likely to fail due to context deps
      on_failure: Create mock for failing component, document in report, continue
      max_component_retries: 2
    PHASE-7_extract_molecules:
      description: Extraction may break organism rendering if not careful
      on_failure: Revert organism changes, keep molecule as standalone, document in report
      max_component_retries: 1
completion_signal: <promise>COMPLETE</promise>
checkpoint_signal: <promise>CHECKPOINT:PHASE-X</promise>
blocked_signal: <promise>BLOCKED:T-X.Y</promise>
outputs:
  scan_results:
    - outputs/design-system/{project}/brownfield/component-inventory.json
    - outputs/design-system/{project}/brownfield/dependency-graph.json
    - outputs/design-system/{project}/brownfield/migration-plan.md
  rename_results:
    - outputs/design-system/{project}/brownfield/rename-report.md
  stories:
    - src/components/**/*.stories.tsx (one per component)
  mocks:
    - .storybook/mocks/*.tsx (provider mocks)
    - .storybook/decorators/*.tsx (story decorators)
  extracted_molecules:
    - src/components/ui/*.tsx (new molecule components)
    - src/components/ui/*.stories.tsx (new molecule stories)
  reports:
    - outputs/design-system/{project}/brownfield/adaptation-report.md
    - outputs/design-system/{project}/brownfield/extraction-report.md
    - Verification report (typecheck, lint, build, coverage)
agents_by_phase:
  PHASE-1:
    primary:
      - "@storybook-expert"
    secondary:
      - "@brad-frost"
  PHASE-2:
    primary:
      - "@storybook-expert"
  PHASE-3:
    primary:
      - "@storybook-expert"
    secondary:
      - "@brad-frost"
  PHASE-4:
    primary:
      - "@storybook-expert"
  PHASE-5:
    primary:
      - "@storybook-expert"
  PHASE-6:
    primary:
      - "@storybook-expert"
    secondary:
      - "@brad-frost"
  PHASE-7:
    primary:
      - "@brad-frost"
    secondary:
      - "@storybook-expert"
  PHASE-8:
    primary:
      - "@storybook-expert"
  PHASE-9:
    primary:
      - "@storybook-expert"
quality_checklist:
  scan:
    - "[ ] All component files discovered"
    - "[ ] Atomic classification applied to every component"
    - "[ ] Dependency graph is complete and acyclic"
    - "[ ] Migration plan phases ordered by dependency"
  atomic_rename:
    - "[ ] Zero stories with legacy title prefix (UI/, Base Components/, Core Components/)"
    - "[ ] All stories use {AtomicLevel}/{Subcategory}/{Name} pattern"
    - "[ ] No changes to story files besides title string"
  atoms:
    - "[ ] All atoms have stories"
    - "[ ] Stories are args-driven (no unnecessary render functions)"
    - "[ ] Gallery stories for multi-variant atoms"
    - "[ ] Titles use Atoms/{Subcategory}/{Name} pattern"
  molecules:
    - "[ ] All molecules have stories"
    - "[ ] Composition patterns shown in render functions"
    - "[ ] Titles use Molecules/{Subcategory}/{Name} pattern"
  organisms:
    - "[ ] All organisms have stories"
    - "[ ] Context dependencies mocked"
    - "[ ] Adaptations documented"
    - "[ ] Titles use Organisms/{Domain}/{Name} pattern"
  extract_molecules:
    - "[ ] Shared patterns across 2+ organisms identified"
    - "[ ] Extracted molecules have stories with Molecules/ prefix"
    - "[ ] Organisms updated to import new molecules"
    - "[ ] No visual regressions in updated organisms"
  templates_pages:
    - "[ ] All templates/pages have stories"
    - "[ ] Layout stories use fullscreen"
    - "[ ] Mock data is representative"
    - "[ ] Templates use Templates/{Name}, Pages use Pages/{Name}"
  verification:
    - "[ ] npm run typecheck — zero errors"
    - "[ ] npm run lint — zero errors"
    - "[ ] npm run build-storybook — succeeds"
    - "[ ] Coverage: 100% of planned components"
    - "[ ] Adaptation report complete"
    - "[ ] All story titles follow Atomic Design hierarchy"
metadata:
  version: "1.0"
  framework: AIOX Design Squad
  created: "2026-02-25"
  primary_use_case: Brownfield component migration to Storybook
  key_difference: |
    Unlike storybook-full-setup (greenfield), this workflow handles
    EXISTING codebases with scattered, undocumented components.
    Key capabilities:
    - Component discovery and atomic classification
    - Dependency-aware migration ordering
    - Context isolation (mock providers, stub data)
    - Same-project and cross-project modes
    - Adaptation tracking and reporting
```


## Referência: references/squad/workflows/storybook-full-setup.yaml

```yaml
workflow:
  id: wf-storybook-full-setup
  name: Storybook Full Setup Pipeline
  version: "1.0"
  orchestrator: "@storybook-expert"
  duration: 1 session
  description: |
    End-to-end pipeline that takes a project from zero Storybook to fully
    configured with stories for every component. Handles:
    - Package installation (Storybook v10 + addons)
    - Configuration (.storybook/main.ts, preview.ts, theme, CSS)
    - shadcn/ui component expansion (full catalog ~45 components)
    - Story generation for ALL components (CSF3, TypeScript strict, autodocs)
    - Verification (typecheck, lint, build, functional)

    This workflow produces:
    - Complete Storybook installation and configuration
    - All shadcn/ui components installed
    - Story files for every component
    - Verification report confirming zero errors
  best_for:
    - New project needs Storybook from scratch
    - Existing project needs stories for all components
    - Design system documentation setup
    - Component library quality gate setup
  decision_matrix_fit:
    awareness: Setup
    sophistication: Standard
    primary_output: Complete Storybook with all stories
  type: legacy
  sequence:
    - step: phase-1
      id: phase-1
      phase: 1
      phase_name: Install Storybook Packages
      agent: storybook-expert
      action: execute_install-storybook-core-framework-adapter-and-all-recommended-add
      next: phase-2
    - step: phase-2
      id: phase-2
      phase: 2
      phase_name: Configure Storybook
      agent: storybook-expert
      action: execute_create
      next: phase-3
    - step: phase-3
      id: phase-3
      phase: 3
      phase_name: Expand shadcn Component Library
      agent: storybook-expert
      action: execute_install-all-shadcn-ui-components-via-cli
      next: phase-4
    - step: phase-4
      id: phase-4
      phase: 4
      phase_name: Generate Stories for All Components
      agent: storybook-expert
      action: execute_generate
      next: phase-5
    - step: phase-5
      id: phase-5
      phase: 5
      phase_name: Verify Complete Setup
      agent: storybook-expert
      action: execute_final-verification-gate
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
phases:
  - id: PHASE-1
    name: Install Storybook Packages
    tier: 0
    description: |
      Install Storybook core, framework adapter, and all recommended addons
      as devDependencies. Detect project framework, select correct adapter,
      add npm scripts.
    tasks:
      - task_file: sb-install.md
        agent: "@storybook-expert"
        required: true
        description: Install all Storybook packages and add scripts
        output: installed_packages, framework_adapter
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - All packages in devDependencies
        - storybook and build-storybook scripts in package.json
        - npx storybook --version returns installed version
      human_review: false
      message: Packages installed. Proceeding to configuration.
  - id: PHASE-2
    name: Configure Storybook
    tier: 0
    description: |
      Create .storybook/main.ts and preview.ts. Configure framework adapter,
      stories glob, addons, theme toggle, global CSS import. Update .gitignore
      and ESLint config.
    tasks:
      - task_file: sb-configure.md
        agent: "@storybook-expert"
        required: true
        description: Create config files and verify Storybook starts
        output: .storybook/main.ts, .storybook/preview.ts
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - .storybook/main.ts exists with correct framework
        - .storybook/preview.ts exists with theme config
        - storybook-static in .gitignore
        - Storybook dev server starts without errors
      human_review: false
      message: Configuration complete. Storybook starts successfully.
  - id: PHASE-3
    name: Expand shadcn Component Library
    tier: 1
    description: |
      Install ALL shadcn/ui components via CLI. Detect existing components,
      install missing ones, apply known fixes (sidebar purity, etc.),
      preserve custom component customizations.
    tasks:
      - task_file: sb-expand-shadcn.md
        agent: "@storybook-expert"
        required: true
        description: Install all shadcn components and apply fixes
        output: installed_components, applied_fixes
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - All target components exist in src/components/ui/
        - npm run typecheck passes
        - npm run lint passes
        - Known shadcn bugs fixed
      human_review: false
      message: All components installed. Proceeding to story generation.
  - id: PHASE-4
    name: Generate Stories for All Components
    tier: 1
    description: |
      Generate .stories.tsx files for EVERY component. CSF3 format with
      satisfies Meta<typeof Component>, TypeScript strict, autodocs tags,
      Portuguese content. Handles simple, compound, form, layout, and
      custom components with appropriate story strategies.
    tasks:
      - task_file: sb-generate-all-stories.md
        agent: "@storybook-expert"
        required: true
        description: Write story files for all components
        output: story_files, coverage_report
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - Every component has a .stories.tsx file
        - npm run typecheck passes
        - npm run lint passes
        - All stories use satisfies Meta pattern
        - All content in Portuguese
      human_review: false
      message: All stories generated. Running final verification.
  - id: PHASE-5
    name: Verify Complete Setup
    tier: 2
    description: |
      Final verification gate. Runs typecheck, lint, build-storybook,
      dev server smoke test, and story coverage check. Produces verification
      report with PASS/FAIL per check.
    tasks:
      - task_file: sb-verify.md
        agent: "@storybook-expert"
        required: true
        description: Run all verification checks and produce report
        output: verification_report
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - "TypeScript: zero errors"
        - "Lint: zero errors"
        - "Build: succeeds"
        - "Coverage: 100%"
        - "Dev server: HTTP 200"
      human_review: true
      message: Verification complete. Review report before finalizing.
error_handling:
  on_phase_failure:
    - log_error: true
    - notify_stakeholders: false
    - create_remediation_task: false
    - halt_workflow: true
  on_checkpoint_failure:
    - log_failure_reason: true
    - return_to_previous_phase: false
    - max_retries: 2
completion_signal: <promise>COMPLETE</promise>
checkpoint_signal: <promise>CHECKPOINT:PHASE-X</promise>
blocked_signal: <promise>BLOCKED:T-X.Y</promise>
outputs:
  configuration:
    - .storybook/main.ts
    - .storybook/preview.ts
    - package.json (updated devDependencies + scripts)
    - .gitignore (storybook-static)
  components:
    - src/components/ui/*.tsx (all shadcn components)
  stories:
    - src/components/ui/*.stories.tsx (one per component)
  reports:
    - Verification report (typecheck, lint, build, coverage)
agents_by_phase:
  PHASE-1:
    primary:
      - "@storybook-expert"
  PHASE-2:
    primary:
      - "@storybook-expert"
  PHASE-3:
    primary:
      - "@storybook-expert"
    secondary:
      - "@brad-frost"
  PHASE-4:
    primary:
      - "@storybook-expert"
  PHASE-5:
    primary:
      - "@storybook-expert"
quality_checklist:
  installation:
    - "[ ] All Storybook packages installed as devDependencies"
    - "[ ] Framework adapter matches project framework"
    - "[ ] npm scripts added (storybook, build-storybook)"
  configuration:
    - "[ ] main.ts has correct stories glob"
    - "[ ] preview.ts imports global CSS"
    - "[ ] Theme toggle works (dark/light)"
    - "[ ] storybook-static in .gitignore"
  components:
    - "[ ] All target shadcn components installed"
    - "[ ] Known generated code bugs fixed"
    - "[ ] Custom components preserved"
  stories:
    - "[ ] Every component has .stories.tsx"
    - "[ ] All use satisfies Meta<typeof Component>"
    - "[ ] All have tags: ['autodocs']"
    - "[ ] Content in Portuguese (pt-BR)"
  verification:
    - "[ ] npm run typecheck — zero errors"
    - "[ ] npm run lint — zero errors"
    - "[ ] npm run build-storybook — succeeds"
    - "[ ] Dev server responds HTTP 200"
metadata:
  version: "1.0"
  framework: AIOX Design Squad
  created: "2026-02-25"
  primary_use_case: Complete Storybook setup from zero to production-ready
  key_difference: |
    Unlike individual story writing (*write-story), this workflow handles
    the ENTIRE pipeline from package installation to full verification.
    Based on real-world execution experience with Storybook v10 + shadcn/ui
    + Tailwind v4 + Next.js.
```
